import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:firebase_core/firebase_core.dart';
import 'firebase_options.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';
import 'package:intl/date_symbol_data_local.dart';

import 'core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'providers/group_provider.dart';
import 'services/notification_service.dart';
import 'providers/chat_provider.dart';
import 'screens/auth/splash_screen.dart'; // ⭐ تم استدعاء الـ Splash Screen هنا

void main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  await EasyLocalization.ensureInitialized();

  await initializeDateFormatting('ar', null);
  await initializeDateFormatting('en', null);

  // ⭐ BULLETPROOF FIX: احتواء صدام التهيئة التلقائية من نظام الأندرويد
  try {
    if (Firebase.apps.isEmpty) {
      await Firebase.initializeApp(
        options: DefaultFirebaseOptions.currentPlatform,
      );
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // التطبيق لن ينهار بعد الآن إذا كان الأندرويد قد جهز Firebase مسبقاً
    debugPrint("Firebase already initialized natively: $e");
  }

  NotificationService.initialize();

  runApp(
    EasyLocalization(
      supportedLocales: const [
        Locale('ar'),
        Locale('en'),
      ],
      path: 'assets/translations',
      fallbackLocale: const Locale('ar'),
      startLocale: const Locale('ar'),
      child: MultiProvider(
        providers: [
          ChangeNotifierProvider(
            create: (_) => GroupProvider(),
          ),
          ChangeNotifierProvider(create: (_) => ChatProvider()),
        ],
        child: const Jam3iyaApp(),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

class Jam3iyaApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const Jam3iyaApp({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
      title: 'Jam3iya',
      theme: AppTheme.lightTheme,
      locale: context.locale,
      supportedLocales: context.supportedLocales,
      localizationsDelegates: context.localizationDelegates,
      // ⭐ تعديل مسار الانطلاق ليكون SplashScreen بدلاً من AuthGate
      // نظام الـ Splash Screen سيفحص Auth داخلياً عبر FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser
      // وينقل المستخدم للمكان الصحيح للحفاظ على نظافة الـ Flow.
      home: const SplashScreen(), 
    );
  }
}

import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';

class CountdownHelper {
  static String format(DateTime date) {
    final diff = date.difference(DateTime.now());

    if (diff.isNegative) return "completed".tr();

    String two(int n) => n.toString().padLeft(2, '0');

    return "${diff.inDays}d "
        "${two(diff.inHours % 24)}h "
        "${two(diff.inMinutes % 60)}m "
        "${two(diff.inSeconds % 60)}s";
  }
}

// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\core\utils\group_intelligence.dart ---
// lib/core/utils/group_intelligence.dart

import '../../models/group_model.dart';

class GroupIntelligence {
  static int totalMonths(Group group) {
    return (group.endDate.year - group.startDate.year) * 12 +
        group.endDate.month -
        group.startDate.month +
        1;
  }

  static String monthStatus(Group group, DateTime month) {
    final key = Group.generateMonthKey(month);
    
    if (group.paidMonths.contains(key)) {
      return "paid";
    }

    final completedCount = group.paidMonths.length;
    final thisIndex = (month.year - group.startDate.year) * 12 +
        month.month -
        group.startDate.month;

    if (thisIndex == completedCount) {
      return "pending";
    }

    if (thisIndex > completedCount) {
      return "locked";
    }

    return "missed";
  }

  

  static bool isCompleted(Group group) {
    final total = totalMonths(group);
    if (total == 0) return true;

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final start = DateTime(group.startDate.year, group.startDate.month);
    final current = DateTime(now.year, now.month);
    int elapsed = (current.year - start.year) * 12 + (current.month - start.month);

    // Trigger: الجمعية تعتبر منتهية إذا انقضت المدة الزمنية أو اكتملت الدفعات
    return elapsed >= total || group.paidMonths.length >= total;
  }

  static int passedMonths(Group group) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final start = DateTime(group.startDate.year, group.startDate.month);
    final current = DateTime(now.year, now.month);

    // إذا لم تبدأ الجمعية بعد
    if (current.isBefore(start)) return 0;

    // حساب الأشهر التي انقضت فعلياً (الفرق الزمني)
    int elapsed = (current.year - start.year) * 12 + (current.month - start.month);
    final total = totalMonths(group);

    // نضمن ألا يتجاوز الرقم الإجمالي وألا يقل عن الصفر
    return elapsed.clamp(0, total);
  }

  static double progress(Group group) {
    final total = totalMonths(group);
    if (total == 0) return 0.0;
    
    final passed = passedMonths(group);
    // حساب النسبة المئوية للتقدم الزمني
    return (passed / total).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
  }

  static int receiveAmount(Group group, int membersCount) {
    return group.monthlyAmount * membersCount;
  }

  static int currentReceiverIndex(Group group, int membersCount) {
    final order = group.receiverOrder.isNotEmpty
        ? group.receiverOrder
        : group.members;

    if (order.isEmpty) return 0;

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final start = DateTime(group.startDate.year, group.startDate.month);
    final current = DateTime(now.year, now.month);

    if (current.isBefore(start)) {
      return -1;
    }

    final elapsed = (current.year - start.year) * 12 + (current.month - start.month);
    return elapsed % order.length;
  }

  static int nextReceiverIndex(Group group, int membersCount) {
    final currentIndex = currentReceiverIndex(group, membersCount);
    if (currentIndex == -1) return 0;

    final order = group.receiverOrder.isNotEmpty
        ? group.receiverOrder
        : group.members;

    if (order.isEmpty) return 0;

    // ⭐ SAFE FIX: إيقاف الدوران (Loop) وإرجاع -1 للدلالة على نهاية الدورة
    if (currentIndex >= order.length - 1) return -1;

    return currentIndex + 1;
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../widgets/app_appbar.dart';
import '../widgets/app_drawer.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';

class MainScaffold extends StatelessWidget {
  final String title;
  final Widget body;
  final int currentIndex;

  final Function(int) onSelectPage;

  const MainScaffold({
    super.key,
    required this.title,
    required this.body,
    required this.onSelectPage,
    required this.currentIndex,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final locale = context.locale; // ⭐ Dependency for language instant updates

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppAppBar(title: title),
      drawer: AppDrawer(onSelectPage: onSelectPage),
      body: body,
      bottomNavigationBar: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.white,
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.05),
              blurRadius: 10,
              offset: const Offset(0, -2),
            )
          ],
        ),
        child: NavigationBar(
          height: 70,
          backgroundColor: Colors.white,
          indicatorColor: const Color(0xFF0F7B6C).withOpacity(0.12),
          labelTextStyle: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
            if (states.contains(WidgetState.selected)) {
              return const TextStyle(
                color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C),
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              );
            }
            return const TextStyle(
              color: Colors.grey,
            );
          }),
          selectedIndex: currentIndex,
          onDestinationSelected: onSelectPage,
          destinations:  [
            NavigationDestination(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.home_outlined),
              selectedIcon: const Icon(
                Icons.home,
                color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C),
              ),
              label: "home".tr(),
            ),
            NavigationDestination(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.groups_outlined),
              selectedIcon: const Icon(
                Icons.groups,
                color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C),
              ),
              label: "groups".tr(),
            ),
            NavigationDestination(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.person_outline),
              selectedIcon: const Icon(
                Icons.person,
                color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C),
              ),
              label: "profile".tr(),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\models\group_model.dart ---
// lib/models/group_model.dart

enum GroupRole {
  leader,
  assistant,
  member,
}

enum PaymentStatus {
  paid,
  pending,
  open,
  locked,
  missed
}

class Group {
  final List<String> paidMonths;
  final String id;
  final String name;
  final int monthlyAmount;
  final String receiverName;
  final DateTime receiveDate;
  final DateTime startDate;
  final DateTime endDate;
  final bool isCompleted;
  final List<String> members;
  final String myUserId;
  final bool isClosed;
  final List<String> pendingMembers;
  final String monthlyMessage;
  final int notificationHour;
  final int notificationMinute;
  final List<String> receiverOrder;
  final Map<String, GroupRole> roles;
  
  /// monthKey -> list of userIds who paid
  final Map<String, List<String>> payments;
  final String groupCode;
  final bool distributionStarted;
  final String chatMode;
  final String lastReminderSentMonth;
  final String paymentQrUrl;
  final bool allowMemberImageMessages;

  

  /// ⭐ Helper: دالة موحدة لإنشاء مفاتيح الأشهر
  static String generateMonthKey(DateTime date) {
    return "${date.year}-${date.month}";
  }

  int get totalMonths {
    return (endDate.year - startDate.year) * 12 +
        (endDate.month - startDate.month) + 1;
  }

  GroupRole get myRole {
    return roles[myUserId] ?? GroupRole.member;
  }

  bool get isLeader => myRole == GroupRole.leader;

  bool get isAssistant => myRole == GroupRole.assistant;

  bool get canManage =>
      myRole == GroupRole.leader ||
      myRole == GroupRole.assistant;

  /// ⭐ Helper: حساب عدد الطلبات المعلقة للمديرين
  int get pendingPaymentsCount {
    int count = 0;
    payments.forEach((key, value) {
      if (key.endsWith("_pending")) {
        count += value.length;
      }
    });
    return count;
  }

  bool hasUserPaid(String monthKey, String userId) {
    final list = payments[monthKey];
    if (list == null) return false;
    return list.contains(userId);
  }

  bool isMemberPaid(String monthKey, String member) {
    if (paidMonths.contains(monthKey)) return true;
    return payments[monthKey]?.contains(member) ?? false;
  }

  bool isMonthFullyPaid(String monthKey) {
    final paid = payments[monthKey] ?? [];
    return paid.length == members.length;
  }

  const Group({
    required this.id,
    required this.name,
    required this.monthlyAmount,
    required this.receiverName,
    required this.receiveDate,
    required this.startDate,
    required this.endDate,
    required this.isCompleted,
    required this.members,
    required this.myUserId,
    required this.roles,
    this.paidMonths = const [],
    this.payments = const {},
    this.groupCode = "",
    this.receiverOrder = const [],
    this.isClosed = false,
    this.pendingMembers = const [],
    this.monthlyMessage = "",
    this.notificationHour = 9,
    this.notificationMinute = 0,
    this.distributionStarted = false,
    this.chatMode = "all_members",
    this.lastReminderSentMonth = "",
    this.paymentQrUrl = "",
    this.allowMemberImageMessages = false,
  });

  Group copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? name,
    int? monthlyAmount,
    String? receiverName,
    DateTime? receiveDate,
    DateTime? startDate,
    DateTime? endDate,
    bool? isCompleted,
    List<String>? members,
    String? myUserId,
    bool? isClosed,
    List<String>? pendingMembers,
    String? monthlyMessage,
    int? notificationHour,
    int? notificationMinute,
    List<String>? receiverOrder,
    Map<String, GroupRole>? roles,
    List<String>? paidMonths,
    Map<String, List<String>>? payments,
    String? groupCode,
    bool? distributionStarted,
    String? chatMode,
    String? lastReminderSentMonth,
    String? paymentQrUrl,
    

  }) {
    return Group(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      name: name ?? this.name,
      monthlyAmount: monthlyAmount ?? this.monthlyAmount,
      receiverName: receiverName ?? this.receiverName,
      receiveDate: receiveDate ?? this.receiveDate,
      startDate: startDate ?? this.startDate,
      endDate: endDate ?? this.endDate,
      isCompleted: isCompleted ?? this.isCompleted,
      members: members ?? this.members,
      myUserId: myUserId ?? this.myUserId,
      isClosed: isClosed ?? this.isClosed,
      pendingMembers: pendingMembers ?? this.pendingMembers,
      monthlyMessage: monthlyMessage ?? this.monthlyMessage,
      notificationHour: notificationHour ?? this.notificationHour,
      notificationMinute: notificationMinute ?? this.notificationMinute,
      receiverOrder: receiverOrder ?? this.receiverOrder,
      roles: roles ?? this.roles,
      paidMonths: paidMonths ?? this.paidMonths,
      payments: payments ?? this.payments,
      groupCode: groupCode ?? this.groupCode,
      distributionStarted: distributionStarted ?? this.distributionStarted,
      chatMode: chatMode ?? this.chatMode,
      paymentQrUrl: paymentQrUrl ?? this.paymentQrUrl,
    );
  }
}

// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\models\message_model.dart ---
//lib/models/message_model.dart//

import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';

class Message {
  final String id;
  final String senderId;
  final String senderName;
  final String text;
  final String imageUrl;
  final DateTime createdAt;
  // ⭐ حقول الـ Soft Delete الجديدة
  final bool isDeleted;
  final String deletedBy;
  final DateTime? deletedAt;

  Message({
    required this.id,
    required this.senderId,
    required this.senderName,
    required this.text,
    this.imageUrl = "",
    required this.createdAt,
    this.isDeleted = false,
    this.deletedBy = "",
    this.deletedAt,
  });

  factory Message.fromFirestore(String id, Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    // ⭐ استرجاع كود تحويل الوقت الذي تم اختصاره بالخطأ
    final rawCreatedAt = data['createdAt'];
    DateTime parsedDate = DateTime.now();
    
    if (rawCreatedAt is Timestamp) {
      parsedDate = rawCreatedAt.toDate();
    } else if (rawCreatedAt is DateTime) {
      parsedDate = rawCreatedAt;
    }

    return Message(
      id: id,
      senderId: data['senderId'] ?? '',
      senderName: data['senderName'] ?? 'user',
      text: data['text'] ?? '',
      imageUrl: data['imageUrl'] ?? '',
      createdAt: parsedDate, // ✅ تم التصحيح هنا
      isDeleted: data['isDeleted'] ?? false, 
      deletedBy: data['deletedBy'] ?? '',
      deletedAt: data['deletedAt'] != null ? (data['deletedAt'] as Timestamp).toDate() : null,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'senderId': senderId,
      'senderName': senderName,
      'text': text,
      'imageUrl': imageUrl, // ⭐ حفظ الصورة
      'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    };
  }
}
// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\models\notification_model.dart ---
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';

class AppNotification {
  final String id;
  final String message;
  final Map<String, dynamic>? args;
  final String? type;      // ⭐ Added to handle UI routing/actions
  final String? groupId;   // ⭐ Added to know which group this belongs to
  final DateTime createdAt;
  final bool read;

  AppNotification({
    required this.id,
    required this.message,
    this.args,
    this.type,
    this.groupId,
    required this.createdAt,
    required this.read,
  });

  factory AppNotification.fromFirestore(String id, Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    final rawCreatedAt = data['createdAt'];

    DateTime createdAt;
    if (rawCreatedAt is Timestamp) {
      createdAt = rawCreatedAt.toDate();
    } else if (rawCreatedAt is DateTime) {
      createdAt = rawCreatedAt;
    } else {
      createdAt = DateTime.now();
    }

    return AppNotification(
      id: id,
      message: (data['message'] ?? '').toString(),
      args: data['args'] != null
          ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(data['args'])
          : null,
      type: data['type']?.toString(),       // ⭐ Parse type
      groupId: data['groupId']?.toString(), // ⭐ Parse groupId
      createdAt: createdAt,
      read: data['read'] == true,
    );
  }
}

// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\providers\chat_provider.dart ---
//lib/providers/chat_provider.dart//

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import '../models/message_model.dart';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:firebase_storage/firebase_storage.dart';

class ChatProvider extends ChangeNotifier {
  final FirebaseFirestore _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;
  final FirebaseAuth _auth = FirebaseAuth.instance;

  Stream<List<Message>> watchMessages(String groupId) {
    return _db
        .collection('groups')
        .doc(groupId)
        .collection('messages')
        .orderBy('createdAt', descending: true)
        .limit(50) // ⭐ STRICT FIX: حماية الميزانية
        .snapshots()
        .map((snapshot) {
      return snapshot.docs.map((doc) => Message.fromFirestore(doc.id, doc.data())).toList();
    });
  }

  Future<void> sendImageMessage(String groupId, File imageFile, String senderName) async {
    final uid = _auth.currentUser?.uid;
    if (uid == null) return;

    try {
      final ext = imageFile.path.split('.').last;
      final ref = FirebaseStorage.instance.ref().child('groups/$groupId/chat/${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.$ext');
      
      await ref.putFile(imageFile);
      final url = await ref.getDownloadURL();

      await _db.collection('groups').doc(groupId).collection('messages').add({
        'senderId': uid,
        'senderName': senderName,
        'text': '', // رسالة فارغة نصياً
        'imageUrl': url,
        'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
    } catch (e) {
      print("Image send failed: $e");
    }
  }

  Future<void> sendMessage(String groupId, String text, String senderName) async {
    final uid = _auth.currentUser?.uid;
    if (uid == null || text.trim().isEmpty) return;

    await _db.collection('groups').doc(groupId).collection('messages').add({
      'senderId': uid,
      'senderName': senderName,
      'text': text.trim(),
      'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  }

  Future<void> updateChatMode(String groupId, String mode) async {
    await _db.collection('groups').doc(groupId).update({
      'chatMode': mode,
    });
  }

  // ⭐ دالة Soft Delete (WhatsApp Style)
  Future<void> softDeleteMessage({
    required String groupId, 
    required String messageId, 
    required String uid,
  }) async {
    try {
      await _db.collection('groups').doc(groupId).collection('messages').doc(messageId).update({
        'isDeleted': true,
        'deletedBy': uid,
        'text': '', // مسح النص الفعلي
        'imageUrl': '', // مسح رابط الصورة الفعلي
        'deletedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("Failed to delete message: $e");
    }
  }
}
// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\providers\group_provider.dart ---
// lib/providers/group_provider.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import '../models/group_model.dart';
import '../repositories/group_repository.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import '../core/utils/group_intelligence.dart';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:firebase_storage/firebase_storage.dart';

class GroupProvider extends ChangeNotifier {
  String get currentUserId => FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid ?? '';

  final GroupRepository _repo = GroupRepository();
  StreamSubscription<List<Group>>? _groupsSub;

  List<Group> _groups = [];
  List<Group> get groups => _groups;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _groupsSub?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  List<String> resolveReceiverOrder(Group group) {
    return group.receiverOrder.isNotEmpty ? group.receiverOrder : group.members;
  }

  Future<void> removeMember({
    required String groupId,
    required String memberId,
  }) async {
    final groupIndex = groups.indexWhere((g) => g.id == groupId);
    if (groupIndex == -1) return;

    final group = groups[groupIndex];

    if (group.roles[memberId] == GroupRole.leader) {
      throw Exception("Cannot remove group leader");
    }

    if (group.myRole == GroupRole.assistant && group.roles[memberId] == GroupRole.assistant) {
      throw Exception("Assistant cannot remove another assistant");
    }

    if (group.members.length <= 2) {
      throw Exception("Group must contain at least 2 members");
    }

    // الحذف الواقعي والمرن: إزالة العضو بالكامل من الأعضاء والترتيب والأدوار فوراً
    final updatedMembers = List<String>.from(group.members)..remove(memberId);
    final updatedOrder = List<String>.from(group.receiverOrder)..remove(memberId);
    
    final updatedRoles = Map<String, String>.from(group.roles.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, v.name)));
    updatedRoles.remove(memberId);

    await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection("groups").doc(groupId).update({
      "members": updatedMembers,
      "receiverOrder": updatedOrder,
      "roles": updatedRoles,
    });

    _groups[groupIndex] = group.copyWith(
      members: updatedMembers,
      receiverOrder: updatedOrder,
      roles: updatedRoles.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, GroupRole.values.firstWhere((e) => e.name == v))),
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> makeMember({
    required String groupId,
    required String memberId,
  }) async {
    final groupIndex = groups.indexWhere((g) => g.id == groupId);
    if (groupIndex == -1) return;
    final group = groups[groupIndex];

    if (!group.isLeader) throw Exception("Only leader can change roles");

    await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection("groups").doc(groupId).update({
      "roles.$memberId": "member",
    });

    final newRoles = Map<String, GroupRole>.from(group.roles);
    newRoles[memberId] = GroupRole.member;

    _groups[groupIndex] = group.copyWith(roles: newRoles);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> makeAssistant({
    required String groupId,
    required String memberId,
  }) async {
    final groupIndex = groups.indexWhere((g) => g.id == groupId);
    if (groupIndex == -1) return;

    final group = groups[groupIndex];

    if (!group.isLeader) throw Exception("Only leader can assign roles");

    if (group.members.isEmpty || group.members.first == memberId) return;

    final updatedRoles = Map<String, String>.from(
      group.roles.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, v.name)),
    );
    updatedRoles[memberId] = "assistant";

    await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection("groups").doc(groupId).update({
      "roles": updatedRoles,
    });

    final newRoles = Map<String, GroupRole>.from(group.roles);
    newRoles[memberId] = GroupRole.assistant;

    _groups[groupIndex] = group.copyWith(roles: newRoles);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> startDistribution(Group group) async {
    final ref = FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection("groups").doc(group.id);
    await ref.update({
      "distributionStarted": true,
      "receiverOrder": group.receiverOrder.isNotEmpty ? group.receiverOrder : group.members,
    });
  }

  Future<void> fixReceiverOrderIfEmpty(Group group) async {
    if (group.receiverOrder.isNotEmpty) return;
    await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('groups').doc(group.id).update({
      "receiverOrder": group.members,
    });
  }

  Future<void> deleteGroup(Group group) async {
    await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('groups').doc(group.id).delete();
  }

  final Map<String, String> _userNameCache = {};

  String? getUserName(String uid) => _userNameCache[uid];

  void updateCachedUserName(String uid, String newName) {
    _userNameCache[uid] = newName;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> loadUserName(String uid) async {
    if (_userNameCache.containsKey(uid)) return;

    try {
      final doc = await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(uid).get();

      if (doc.exists) {
        _userNameCache[uid] = (doc.data() as Map<String, dynamic>?)?['name'] ?? '';
      } else {
        _userNameCache[uid] = '';
      }
    } catch (_) {
      _userNameCache[uid] = '';
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> preloadUserNames(List<String> uids) async {
    final missing = uids.where((uid) => !_userNameCache.containsKey(uid)).toList();

    if (missing.isEmpty) return;

    for (var i = 0; i < missing.length; i += 30) {
      final chunk = missing.skip(i).take(30).toList();

      try {
        final snapshot = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
            .collection('users')
            .where(FieldPath.documentId, whereIn: chunk)
            .get();

        for (var doc in snapshot.docs) {
          _userNameCache[doc.id] = (doc.data() as Map<String, dynamic>?)?['name'] ?? '';
        }
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint("Failed to load chunk of usernames: $e");
      }
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> updateGroupSettings(
    Group group,
    DateTime newStart,
    DateTime newEnd,
    List<String> newOrder,
    String message,
    int hour,
    int minute,
  ) async {
    if (group.isClosed) throw Exception("Group is closed");

    final ref = FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('groups').doc(group.id);
    await ref.update({
      "startMonth": "${newStart.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-${newStart.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-01",
      "endMonth": "${newEnd.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-${newEnd.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-01",
      "receiverOrder": newOrder,
      "monthlyMessage": message,
      "notificationHour": hour,
      "notificationMinute": minute,
    });

    final index = _groups.indexWhere((g) => g.id == group.id);
    if (index != -1) {
      _groups[index] = _groups[index].copyWith(
        startDate: newStart,
        endDate: newEnd,
        receiverOrder: newOrder,
        monthlyMessage: message,
        notificationHour: hour,
        notificationMinute: minute,
      );
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> closeGroup(Group group) async {
    await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('groups').doc(group.id).update({
      "isClosed": true,
    });
  }

  Future<void> markEntireMonthAsPaid(Group group, DateTime month) async {
    final key = Group.generateMonthKey(month);
    final ref = FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('groups').doc(group.id);

    await FirebaseFirestore.instance.runTransaction((transaction) async {
      final snapshot = await transaction.get(ref);
      if (!snapshot.exists) return;
      final data = snapshot.data() as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};
      
      final members = List<String>.from(data['members'] ?? []);
      final payments = Map<String, dynamic>.from(data['payments'] ?? {});
      final paidMonths = List<String>.from(data['paidMonths'] ?? []);

      payments[key] = members;
      if (!paidMonths.contains(key)) paidMonths.add(key);

      transaction.update(ref, {"payments": payments, "paidMonths": paidMonths});
    });

    final index = _groups.indexWhere((g) => g.id == group.id);

    if (index != -1) {
      final old = _groups[index];

      _groups[index] = old.copyWith(
        paidMonths: old.paidMonths.contains(key) ? old.paidMonths : [...old.paidMonths, key],
        payments: {...old.payments, key: List<String>.from(old.members)},
      );
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> approveMember(Group group, String userId) async {
    final ref = FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('groups').doc(group.id);

    await FirebaseFirestore.instance.runTransaction((transaction) async {
      final snapshot = await transaction.get(ref);
      if (!snapshot.exists) return;
      final data = snapshot.data() as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};
      
      final members = List<String>.from(data['members'] ?? []);
      final pending = List<String>.from(data['pendingMembers'] ?? []);
      final roles = Map<String, dynamic>.from(data['roles'] ?? {});

      if (!pending.contains(userId)) return;

      pending.remove(userId);
      members.add(userId);
      roles[userId] = 'member';

      final receiverOrder = List<String>.from(data['receiverOrder'] ?? []);
      if (!receiverOrder.contains(userId)) receiverOrder.add(userId);

      transaction.update(ref, {
        "members": members,
        "pendingMembers": pending,
        "roles": roles,
        "receiverOrder": receiverOrder,
      });
    });

    await createNotification(uid: userId, text: "you_were_approved", type: "approved", groupId: group.id);
  }

  Future<void> rejectMember(Group group, String userId) async {
    final ref = FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('groups').doc(group.id);

    await FirebaseFirestore.instance.runTransaction((transaction) async {
      final snapshot = await transaction.get(ref);
      if (!snapshot.exists) return;
      final data = snapshot.data() as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};
      
      final pending = List<String>.from(data['pendingMembers'] ?? []);
      if (!pending.contains(userId)) return;
      pending.remove(userId);
      transaction.update(ref, {"pendingMembers": pending});
    });

    await createNotification(uid: userId, text: "your_request_rejected", type: "rejected", groupId: group.id);
  }

  Future<void> joinGroup(String code) async {
    try {
      await _repo.joinGroupByCode(code, currentUserId);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e.toString().contains("closed")) throw Exception("closed");
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Group? getGroup(String id) {
    try {
      return _groups.firstWhere((g) => g.id == id);
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  List<Group> get all => _groups;

  List<Group> get active => _groups.where((g) => !GroupIntelligence.isCompleted(g)).toList();
  List<Group> get completed => _groups.where((g) => GroupIntelligence.isCompleted(g)).toList();

  void markMonthAsPaid(Group group, DateTime month) {
    final key = Group.generateMonthKey(month);

    final index = _groups.indexWhere((g) => g.id == group.id);
    if (index == -1) return;

    final old = _groups[index];
    if (old.paidMonths.contains(key)) return;

    _groups[index] = old.copyWith(paidMonths: [...old.paidMonths, key]);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> markMemberAsPaid(Group group, DateTime month, String member) async {
    final key = Group.generateMonthKey(month);
    final pendingKey = "${key}_pending";
    final ref = FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('groups').doc(group.id);

    await FirebaseFirestore.instance.runTransaction((transaction) async {
      final snapshot = await transaction.get(ref);
      if (!snapshot.exists) return;
      final data = snapshot.data() as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};
      
      final payments = Map<String, dynamic>.from(data['payments'] ?? {});
      final paidList = List<String>.from(payments[key] ?? []);
      final pendingList = List<String>.from(payments[pendingKey] ?? []);
      
      final membersList = List<String>.from(data['members'] ?? []);
      final paidMonthsList = List<String>.from(data['paidMonths'] ?? []);

      if (!paidList.contains(member)) paidList.add(member);
      pendingList.remove(member);
      payments[key] = paidList;
      payments[pendingKey] = pendingList;

      if (paidList.length == membersList.length && !paidMonthsList.contains(key)) {
        paidMonthsList.add(key);
      }

      transaction.update(ref, {"payments": payments, "paidMonths": paidMonthsList});
    });

    final index = _groups.indexWhere((g) => g.id == group.id);

    if (index != -1) {
      final old = _groups[index];

      final newPayments = Map<String, List<String>>.from(old.payments);
      final list = List<String>.from(newPayments[key] ?? []);
      
      if (!list.contains(member)) list.add(member);
      newPayments[key] = list;

      List<String> newPaidMonths = List.from(old.paidMonths);
      if (list.length == old.members.length && !newPaidMonths.contains(key)) {
          newPaidMonths.add(key);
      }

      _groups[index] = old.copyWith(payments: newPayments, paidMonths: newPaidMonths);
      notifyListeners();
    }
    
    await createNotification(
      uid: member,
      text: "payment_approved",
      args: {"month": "${month.month}/${month.year}"},
      type: "payment_approved",
      groupId: group.id,
    );
  }

  Future<void> requestPayment(Group group, DateTime month, String member) async {
    if (group.isClosed) throw Exception("Group is closed");
    
    final key = Group.generateMonthKey(month);
    final index = _groups.indexWhere((g) => g.id == group.id);
    if (index == -1) return;
    
    final old = _groups[index];
    final newPayments = Map<String, List<String>>.from(old.payments);
    final pendingKey = "${key}_pending";
    final pending = List<String>.from(newPayments[pendingKey] ?? []);
    
    if (pending.contains(member)) return;
    pending.add(member);
    newPayments[pendingKey] = pending;

    await _repo.updatePayments(groupId: group.id, payments: newPayments);
    
    final targetUids = <String>{};
    for (var entry in group.roles.entries) {
      if (entry.value == GroupRole.leader || entry.value == GroupRole.assistant) {
        targetUids.add(entry.key);
      }
    }

    if (targetUids.isEmpty && group.members.isNotEmpty) {
      targetUids.add(group.members.first);
    }

    String memberName = member;
    try {
      final doc = await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(member).get();
      if (doc.exists && doc.data() != null) {
        memberName = (doc.data() as Map<String, dynamic>)['name'] ?? member;
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    for (var uid in targetUids) {
      await createNotification(
        uid: uid,
        text: "payment_request",
        args: {"user": memberName, "month": "${month.month}/${month.year}"},
        type: "payment_request",
        groupId: group.id,
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> createNotification({
    required String uid,
    required String text,
    required String type,
    Map<String, dynamic>? args,
    String? groupId,
  }) async {
    await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(uid).collection('notifications').add({
      "message": text,
      "args": args ?? {},
      "createdAt": FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      "read": false,
      "type": type,
      "groupId": groupId,
    });
  }

  Future<void> rejectPaymentRequest(Group group, DateTime month, String member) async {
    final key = Group.generateMonthKey(month);

    final pendingKey = "${key}_pending";
    final ref = FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('groups').doc(group.id);
    
    final snapshot = await ref.get();
    if (!snapshot.exists) return;

    final data = snapshot.data() as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};

    final payments = Map<String, List<String>>.from(
      (data['payments'] ?? {}).map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, List<String>.from(v))),
    );

    final pending = List<String>.from(payments[pendingKey] ?? []);
    pending.remove(member);
    payments[pendingKey] = pending;

    await ref.update({"payments": payments});

    // ⭐ SAFE FIX #3: إرسال إشعار للمستخدم بأن طلبه رُفض
    await createNotification(
      uid: member,
      text: "your_request_rejected", // إعادة استخدام مفتاح الترجمة هذا
      type: "payment_rejected",
      groupId: group.id,
    );
  }

  Future<void> loadGroups() async {
    await _groupsSub?.cancel();

    _groupsSub = _repo.watchGroups(currentUserId).listen((groups) {
      for (var g in groups) fixReceiverOrderIfEmpty(g);
      _groups = groups;
      notifyListeners();
    });
  }

  Future<void> addGroup(Group group) async {
    await _repo.createGroup(group);
  }

  Future<void> sendPaymentReminder(Group group, DateTime month) async {
    await _repo.sendPaymentReminder(group: group, month: month);
  }

  void updateGroup(Group updated) {
    final index = _groups.indexWhere((g) => g.id == updated.id);

    if (index != -1) {
      _groups[index] = updated;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }
  // ⭐ دالة رفع وتحديث صورة الـ QR / Overview (مؤمنة بالكامل)
  Future<void> updateGroupOverviewImage(String groupId, File imageFile, String oldUrl) async {
    // 1) تأمين الحذف: مسح الصورة القديمة لتوفير المساحة بدون كسر الـ Flow
    if (oldUrl.isNotEmpty) {
      try {
// ⭐ FIX: إضافة Timeout لمنع تجميد عملية الرفع إذا كان السيرفر لا يرد على طلب الحذف
        await FirebaseStorage.instance.refFromURL(oldUrl).delete().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));      } catch (e) {
        // Safe Ignore: إذا كانت الصورة محذوفة أو الرابط تالف، تجاهل الخطأ وأكمل الرفع (يمنع 404 Crash)
        debugPrint("Safe ignore: Old image not found.");
      }
    }

    // 2) الرفع الجديد
    try {
      final ext = imageFile.path.split('.').last;
      final ref = FirebaseStorage.instance.ref().child('groups/$groupId/overview_img_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.$ext');
      
      await ref.putFile(imageFile);
      final url = await ref.getDownloadURL();

      await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('groups').doc(groupId).update({
        'paymentQrUrl': url,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("Upload Error: $e");
      throw Exception("Failed to upload image");
    }
  }
}

// lib/repositories/group_repository.dart

import '../models/group_model.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';

class GroupRepository {
  final _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;

  Future<void> joinGroupByCode(String code, String userId) async {
    final query = await _db
        .collection('groups')
        .where('groupCode', isEqualTo: code.trim().toUpperCase())
        .limit(1)
        .get();

    if (query.docs.isEmpty) throw Exception("not_found");

    final doc = query.docs.first;
    final ref = doc.reference;
    final userRef = _db.collection('users').doc(userId);

    String leaderId = "";
    String name = userId;

    await _db.runTransaction((transaction) async {
      final snapshot = await transaction.get(ref);
      final userSnapshot = await transaction.get(userRef);
      
      if (!snapshot.exists) throw Exception("not_found");

      final data = snapshot.data()!;
      final bool isClosed = data['isClosed'] ?? false;

      if (isClosed) throw Exception("closed");

      final members = List<String>.from(data['members'] ?? []);
      final pending = List<String>.from(data['pendingMembers'] ?? []);

      if (members.contains(userId)) throw Exception("already_member");
      if (pending.contains(userId)) throw Exception("already_requested");

      pending.add(userId);
      name = userSnapshot.data()?['name'] ?? userId;
      final roles = Map<String, dynamic>.from(data['roles'] ?? {});
      
      final leaderEntry = roles.entries.where((e) => e.value == 'leader');
      leaderId = leaderEntry.isNotEmpty ? leaderEntry.first.key : members.first;

      transaction.update(ref, {"pendingMembers": pending});
    });

    // FIX: Do not silently hide notification errors. Let them propagate appropriately.
    final notificationRef = _db.collection('users').doc(leaderId).collection('notifications').doc();
    await notificationRef.set({
      "message": "join_request",
      "args": {"user": name},
      "createdAt": FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      "read": false,
    });
  }

  String _generateGroupCode() {
    const chars = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';
    final rand = Random();
    return List.generate(6, (_) => chars[rand.nextInt(chars.length)]).join();
  }

  Future<void> updatePayments({
    required String groupId,
    required Map<String, List<String>> payments,
  }) async {
    final ref = _db.collection('groups').doc(groupId);

    await _db.runTransaction((transaction) async {
      final snapshot = await transaction.get(ref);
      if (!snapshot.exists) throw Exception("Group not found");

      final data = snapshot.data()!;
      final members = List<String>.from(data['members'] ?? []);
      final paidMonths = List<String>.from(data['paidMonths'] ?? []);

      payments.forEach((monthKey, paidList) {
        if (monthKey.contains("_pending")) return;
        if (paidList.length == members.length && !paidMonths.contains(monthKey)) {
          paidMonths.add(monthKey);
        }
      });

      transaction.update(ref, {
        "payments": payments,
        "paidMonths": paidMonths,
      });
    });
  }

  Future<void> createGroup(Group group) async {
    String code = _generateGroupCode();
    final uid = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid;
    
    if (uid == null) throw Exception("User not logged in");

    List<String> members = List<String>.from(group.members);
    if (!members.contains(uid)) {
      members.add(uid);
    }

    Map<String, String> rolesMap = group.roles.map((key, value) => MapEntry(key, value.name));
    rolesMap[uid] = 'leader';

    await _db.collection('groups').add({
      "name": group.name,
      "monthlyAmount": group.monthlyAmount,
      "startMonth": "${group.startDate.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-${group.startDate.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-01",
      "endMonth": "${group.endDate.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-${group.endDate.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-01",
      "distributionStarted": false,
      "members": members,
      "pendingMembers": [],
      "isClosed": false,
      "monthlyMessage": group.monthlyMessage,
      "notificationHour": group.notificationHour,
      "notificationMinute": group.notificationMinute,
      "myUserId": uid,
      "roles": rolesMap,
      "payments": {},
      "paidMonths": [],
      "groupCode": code.toUpperCase(),
      "receiverOrder": group.receiverOrder.isEmpty ? members : group.receiverOrder,
      "chatMode": "all_members", // ⭐ SAFE FIX: حفظ الحالة الافتراضية
      "lastReminderSentMonth": "",
      "allowMemberImageMessages": false, // ⭐ إضافة الحقل الافتراضي لمنع الأعضاء مبدئياً
    });
  }

  DateTime _safeParseDate(dynamic dateString, DateTime fallback) {
    if (dateString == null) return fallback;
    try {
      return DateTime.parse(dateString.toString());
    } catch (e) {
      return fallback;
    }
  }

  Future<List<Group>> getGroups() async {
    final snapshot = await _db.collection('groups').get();
    return snapshot.docs.map((doc) => _mapDocToGroup(doc.id, doc.data(), "unknown")).toList();
  }

  Stream<List<Group>> watchGroups(String userId) {
    // ⭐ ROOT CAUSE FIX: 
    // استخدام استعلام بسيط وفعال يمنع الفشل الصامت بسبب الفهارس المركبة (Composite Indexes).
    // هذا سيضمن عودة الجروبات للظهور فوراً متى ما كان المستخدم عضواً فيها.
    return _db.collection('groups')
        .where('members', arrayContains: userId)
        .snapshots()
        .map((snapshot) {
      return snapshot.docs.map((doc) => _mapDocToGroup(doc.id, doc.data(), userId)).toList();
    });
  }

  Group _mapDocToGroup(String docId, Map<String, dynamic> data, String userId) {
    return Group(
      id: docId,
      name: data['name'] ?? '',
      monthlyAmount: data['monthlyAmount'] ?? 0,
      receiverName: '',
      receiveDate: DateTime.now(),
      startDate: _safeParseDate(data['startMonth'], DateTime.now()),
      endDate: _safeParseDate(data['endMonth'] ?? data['startMonth'], DateTime.now()),
      distributionStarted: data['distributionStarted'] ?? false,
      isCompleted: false,
      members: List<String>.from(data['members'] ?? []),
      pendingMembers: List<String>.from(data['pendingMembers'] ?? []),
      receiverOrder: List<String>.from(data['receiverOrder'] ?? []),
      myUserId: userId,
      isClosed: data['isClosed'] ?? false,
      monthlyMessage: data['monthlyMessage'] ?? "",
      notificationHour: data['notificationHour'] ?? 9,
      notificationMinute: data['notificationMinute'] ?? 0,
      roles: (data['roles'] as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {}).map((k, v) => MapEntry(
            k,
            GroupRole.values.firstWhere((e) => e.name == v, orElse: () => GroupRole.member),
          )),
      payments: Map<String, List<String>>.from((data['payments'] ?? {}).map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, List<String>.from(v)))),
      groupCode: data['groupCode'] ?? '',
      chatMode: data['chatMode'] ?? 'all_members', // ⭐ SAFE FIX: قراءة حالة الشات الفعلية
      lastReminderSentMonth: data['lastReminderSentMonth'] ?? '',
      paymentQrUrl: data['paymentQrUrl'] ?? '', // ⭐ قراءة الرابط
      allowMemberImageMessages: data['allowMemberImageMessages'] ?? false, // ⭐ قراءة صلاحية الصور
    );
  }

  Future<void> sendPaymentReminder({required Group group, required DateTime month}) async {
    final key = Group.generateMonthKey(month);
    final paid = group.payments[key] ?? [];
    final unpaidMembers = group.members.where((m) => !paid.contains(m)).toList();

    if (unpaidMembers.isEmpty) return;

    for (final uid in unpaidMembers) {
      // FIX: Do not silently swallow errors.
      await _db.collection('users').doc(uid).collection('notifications').add({
        "message": "payment_reminder",
        "args": {"month": key},
        "createdAt": FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        "read": false,
      });
    }
  }

  List<Group> getActiveGroups() => [];
  List<Group> getCompletedGroups() => [];
  List<Group> getAllGroups() => [];
}

  // 1. بناء مسار الخطوات (Timeline)
  Widget _buildStep(int number, IconData icon, String title, String desc, {bool isLast = false}) {
    return Row(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Column(
          children: [
            CircleAvatar(
              radius: 13,
              backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0F7B6C).withOpacity(0.12),
              child: Text(
                number.toString(), 
                style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C), fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 12),
              ),
            ),
            if (!isLast)
              Container(
                width: 2.5,
                height: 26,
                margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
                color: Colors.grey.shade300,
              ),
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 14),
        Expanded(
          child: Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: isLast ? 0 : 12),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(icon, size: 18, color: const Color(0xFF0F7B6C)),
                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        title, 
                        style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14, color: Color(0xFF1A1A1A)),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(
                  desc, 
                  style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF4A4A4A), fontSize: 13, height: 1.4),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  // 2. بناء عنصر السؤال الشائع (FAQ Item)
  Widget _buildFaqItem(String question, String answerStr, {bool isLast = false}) {
    // تجهيز النص المتعدد الأسطر ليصبح نقاط مرتبة (Bullet Points)
    List<String> answerLines = answerStr.split('\n');

    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        border: Border(
          bottom: isLast ? BorderSide.none : BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade100, width: 1),
        ),
      ),
      child: Theme(
        data: ThemeData(dividerColor: Colors.transparent),
        child: ExpansionTile(
          iconColor: const Color(0xFF0F7B6C),
          collapsedIconColor: Colors.grey,
          tilePadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18, vertical: 0),
          title: Text(
            question,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              fontSize: 14,
              color: Color(0xFF1A1A1A),
            ),
          ),
          childrenPadding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 0, 24, 16),
          expandedAlignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
          children: [
            Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                ...answerLines.map((line) {
                  return Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8.0),
                    child: Row(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        const Padding(
                          padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 6.0, left: 4.0, right: 8.0),
                          child: Icon(Icons.circle, size: 6, color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C)),
                        ),
                        Expanded(
                          child: Text(
                            line.trim(),
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              color: Color(0xFF4A4A4A),
                              fontSize: 13,
                              height: 1.5,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  );
                }),
                // ⚠️ Future-Proofing: مكان مخصص برمجياً لإضافة صور لاحقاً
                // const SizedBox(height: 10),
                // ClipRRect(
                //   borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                //   child: Image.asset('assets/images/placeholder.png'),
                // ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// lib/screens/auth/login_form_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';
import 'package:jam3iya_app/screens/auth/recovery_login_screen.dart';
import '../navigation/main_navigation.dart';
import 'register_form_screen.dart';
import '../../services/notification_service.dart';

class LoginFormScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const LoginFormScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<LoginFormScreen> createState() => _LoginFormScreenState();
}

class _LoginFormScreenState extends State<LoginFormScreen> {
  final usernameController = TextEditingController();
  final passwordController = TextEditingController();

  bool loading = false;

  Future<void> login() async {
// ⭐ STRICT FIX: توحيد حالة الأحرف لتجنب تضارب الحسابات
    final username = usernameController.text.trim().toLowerCase(); 
    final password = passwordController.text.trim();

    if (username.isEmpty || password.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text("enterUsernamePassword".tr())),
      );
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      loading = true;
    });

    try {
      final email = "$username@app.com";
      await FirebaseAuth.instance.signInWithEmailAndPassword(
        email: email,
        password: password,
      );

      NotificationService.saveFCMToken(); // Fire and forget

      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pushAndRemoveUntil(
          context,
          MaterialPageRoute(
            builder: (_) => const MainNavigation(),
          ),
          (route) => false,
        );
      }
    } on FirebaseAuthException catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        String errorMsg = "error_generic".tr();
        if (e.code == 'user-not-found' || e.code == 'invalid-credential' || e.code == 'invalid-email') {
          errorMsg = "error_user_not_found".tr();
        } else if (e.code == 'wrong-password') {
          errorMsg = "error_wrong_password".tr();
        } else if (e.code == 'network-request-failed') {
          errorMsg = "error_network".tr();
        }

        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text(errorMsg)),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text("error_generic".tr())),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      // ⭐ STRICT FIX: Guarantees loading ALWAYS stops if it didn't navigate away
      if (mounted) setState(() => loading = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final locale = context.locale; // Ensure translations update instantly
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text("login".tr())),
      body: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            TextField(
              controller: usernameController,
              enabled: !loading,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                labelText: "username".tr(),
                border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            TextField(
              controller: passwordController,
              enabled: !loading,
              obscureText: true,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                labelText: "password".tr(),
                border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              child: ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: loading ? null : login,
                child: loading
                    ? const SizedBox(
                        height: 22, width: 22, 
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2))
                    : Text("login".tr()),
              ),
            ),
            TextButton(
              onPressed: loading ? null : () {
                Navigator.push(context, MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const RegisterFormScreen()));
              },
              child: Text("createAccount".tr()),
            ),
            // ⭐ زر استعادة الحساب
            TextButton(
              onPressed: loading ? null : () {
                Navigator.push(context, MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const RecoveryLoginScreen()));
              },
              child: const Text("نسيت بياناتك؟ استخدم رمز الدخول", style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\screens\auth\login_screen.dart ---
// lib/screens/auth/login_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';

import '../navigation/main_navigation.dart';
import '../../services/notification_service.dart';

class LoginScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const LoginScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<LoginScreen> createState() => _LoginScreenState();
}

class _LoginScreenState extends State<LoginScreen> {
  final usernameController = TextEditingController();
  final passwordController = TextEditingController();

  bool loading = false;

  Future<void> login() async {
    final email = usernameController.text.trim();
    final password = passwordController.text.trim();

    if (email.isEmpty || password.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text("Enter the user and password")),
      );
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      loading = true;
    });

    try {
      await FirebaseAuth.instance.signInWithEmailAndPassword(
        email: email,
        password: password,
      );

      NotificationService.saveFCMToken(); // Fire and forget

      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pushAndRemoveUntil(
          context,
          MaterialPageRoute(
            builder: (_) => const MainNavigation(),
          ),
          (route) => false,
        );
      }
    } on FirebaseAuthException catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text(e.message ?? "Login failed")),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text("Login failed")),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      // ⭐ STRICT FIX: Guarantees loading ALWAYS stops if it didn't navigate away
      if (mounted) setState(() => loading = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text("Login"),
      ),
      body: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            TextField(
              controller: usernameController,
              enabled: !loading,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                labelText: "Username",
                border: OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            TextField(
              controller: passwordController,
              enabled: !loading,
              obscureText: true,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                labelText: "Password",
                border: OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              child: ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: loading ? null : login,
                child: loading
                    ? const SizedBox(
                        height: 22,
                        width: 22,
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                      )
                    : const Text("Login"),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\screens\auth\recovery_login_screen.dart ---
// lib/screens/auth/recovery_login_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import '../navigation/main_navigation.dart';

class RecoveryLoginScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const RecoveryLoginScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<RecoveryLoginScreen> createState() => _RecoveryLoginScreenState();
}

class _RecoveryLoginScreenState extends State<RecoveryLoginScreen> {
  final usernameController = TextEditingController();
  final codeController = TextEditingController();
  bool loading = false;

  Future<void> recoveryLogin() async {
    final username = usernameController.text.trim().toLowerCase();
    final code = codeController.text.trim().toUpperCase();

    if (username.isEmpty || code.isEmpty) return;

    setState(() => loading = true);

    try {
      // 1. دخول مجهول آمن ومؤقت لتخطي حماية القراءة في Firestore (Anonymous Bypass)
      final anonCred = await FirebaseAuth.instance.signInAnonymously();

      // 2. فحص المستند باستخدام Username و Recovery Code فقط
      final query = await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users')
          .where('username', isEqualTo: username)
          .where('recoveryCode', isEqualTo: code)
          .limit(1)
          .get();

      if (query.docs.isEmpty) {
        await anonCred.user?.delete(); // تنظيف سريع
        throw Exception('بيانات غير صحيحة');
      }

      // 3. جلب كلمة المرور المخفية وإعداد الإيميل
      final realPassword = query.docs.first.data()['_p'];
      final email = "$username@app.com";

      // 4. حذف الحساب المجهول نهائياً لمنع النفايات في Firebase Auth
      await anonCred.user?.delete();

      // 5. تسجيل الدخول الفعلي بحساب المستخدم الأصلي
      await FirebaseAuth.instance.signInWithEmailAndPassword(
        email: email,
        password: realPassword,
      );

      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pushAndRemoveUntil(
          context,
          MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const MainNavigation()),
          (route) => false,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text("اسم المستخدم أو رمز الدخول غير صحيح")),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => loading = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text("استرجاع الحساب")),
      body: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            const Text(
              "أدخل اسم المستخدم ورمز الدخول الخاص بك لاستعادة حسابك.",
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey, fontSize: 15),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 32),
            TextField(
              controller: usernameController,
              enabled: !loading,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: "اسم المستخدم", border: OutlineInputBorder()),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            TextField(
              controller: codeController,
              enabled: !loading,
              textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.characters,
              decoration: InputDecoration( // إزالة الـ const لوجود TextStyle
                labelText: "رمز الدخول", 
                hintText: "مثال: JM3Y-84KP-X2",
                // ⭐ Soft Placeholder: رمادي فاتح جداً وغير مزعج
                hintStyle: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey.shade400, fontWeight: FontWeight.normal, fontSize: 14),
                border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              child: ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: loading ? null : recoveryLogin,
                child: loading 
                    ? const SizedBox(height: 22, width: 22, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: Colors.white))
                    : const Text("دخول"),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\screens\auth\register_form_screen.dart ---
// lib/screens/auth/register_form_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';
import '../navigation/main_navigation.dart';
import '../../services/notification_service.dart';
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

class RegisterFormScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const RegisterFormScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<RegisterFormScreen> createState() => _RegisterFormScreenState();
}

class _RegisterFormScreenState extends State<RegisterFormScreen> {
  final nameController = TextEditingController();
  final usernameController = TextEditingController();
  final passwordController = TextEditingController();

  bool loading = false;

  Future<void> register() async {
    final name = nameController.text.trim();
// ⭐ STRICT FIX: توحيد حالة الأحرف لتجنب تضارب الحسابات
    final username = usernameController.text.trim().toLowerCase();
      final password = passwordController.text.trim();

    if (name.isEmpty || username.isEmpty || password.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text("fillAllFields".tr())),
      );
      return;
    }

    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$').hasMatch(username)) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text("error_username_format".tr())),
      );
      return;
    }

    if (password.length < 6) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text("error_password_length".tr())),
      );
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      loading = true;
    });

    try {
      final email = "$username@app.com";

      final cred = await FirebaseAuth.instance.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(
        email: email,
        password: password,
      );

      final uid = cred.user!.uid;

      // ⭐ إنشاء رمز دخول مميز
      final rand = Random();
      final String recoveryCode = "JM3Y-${rand.nextInt(9999).toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-${rand.nextInt(99).toString().padLeft(2, '0')}";

      await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(uid).set({
        "name": name,
        "username": username,
        "recoveryCode": recoveryCode, // ⭐ حفظ الكود
        "_p": password, // ⭐ الاحتفاظ بالباسوورد برمجياً للاسترجاع (Alpha Safe Logic)
        "createdAt": FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });

      NotificationService.saveFCMToken(); // Fire and forget

      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => loading = false); // إيقاف التحميل لعرض الرسالة
        showDialog(
          context: context,
          barrierDismissible: false, // ⭐ لا يمكن إغلاقه بالضغط بالخارج
          builder: (dialogContext) {
            return AlertDialog(
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
              title: const Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(Icons.vpn_key, color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C)),
                  SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Text("رمز الدخول السري"),
                ],
              ),
              content: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  const Text(
                    "احفظ رمز الدخول هذا خارج التطبيق.\nستحتاجه إذا نسيت بيانات تسجيل الدخول.",
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.redAccent),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12, horizontal: 20),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(color: const Color(0xFFF6F8F7), borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12), border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFF0F7B6C).withOpacity(0.3))),
                    child: SelectableText(recoveryCode, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 20, letterSpacing: 2, color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C))),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              actions: [
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: () {
                    Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: recoveryCode));
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text("تم نسخ الرمز بنجاح")));
                  },
                  child: const Text("نسخ الرمز"),
                ),
                ElevatedButton(
                  onPressed: () {
                    Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
                    Navigator.pushAndRemoveUntil(context, MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const MainNavigation()), (route) => false);
                  },
                  child: const Text("متابعة"),
                ),
              ],
            );
          }
        );
      }
    } on FirebaseAuthException catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        String errorMsg = "error_generic".tr();
        if (e.code == 'email-already-in-use') {
          errorMsg = "error_email_in_use".tr();
        } else if (e.code == 'weak-password') {
          errorMsg = "error_weak_password".tr();
        } else if (e.code == 'network-request-failed') {
          errorMsg = "error_network".tr();
        }
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text(errorMsg)),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text("error_generic".tr())),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      // ⭐ STRICT FIX: Guarantees loading ALWAYS stops if it didn't navigate away
      if (mounted) setState(() => loading = false); 
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final locale = context.locale; // Ensure translations update instantly
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text("createAccount".tr())),
      body: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            TextField(
              controller: nameController,
              enabled: !loading,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                labelText: "yourName".tr(),
                border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            TextField(
              controller: usernameController,
              enabled: !loading,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                labelText: "username".tr(),
                border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            TextField(
              controller: passwordController,
              enabled: !loading,
              obscureText: true,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                labelText: "password".tr(),
                border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              child: ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: loading ? null : register,
                child: loading
                    ? const SizedBox(
                        height: 22, width: 22, 
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2))
                    : Text("createAccount".tr()),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// lib/screens/auth/splash_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'welcome_screen.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import '../navigation/main_navigation.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../../providers/group_provider.dart';

class SplashScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SplashScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<SplashScreen> createState() => _SplashScreenState();
}

class _SplashScreenState extends State<SplashScreen> with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _controller;
  late Animation<double> _scaleAnimation;
  late Animation<double> _fadeAnimation;
  late Animation<double> _textFadeAnimation;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    // إعداد الـ Controller لمدة 2.2 ثانية لتجربة Premium Smooth
    _controller = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 2200),
    );

    // حركة تكبير بطيئة وسلسة (Scale) من 0.7 إلى 1.0
    _scaleAnimation = Tween<double>(begin: 0.7, end: 1.0).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(
        parent: _controller,
        curve: const Interval(0.0, 0.6, curve: Curves.easeOutCubic),
      ),
    );

    // حركة ظهور (Fade) للشعار
    _fadeAnimation = Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(
        parent: _controller,
        curve: const Interval(0.0, 0.4, curve: Curves.easeIn),
      ),
    );

    // ظهور متأخر لاسم التطبيق لمزيد من الأناقة
    _textFadeAnimation = Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(
        parent: _controller,
        curve: const Interval(0.5, 0.9, curve: Curves.easeIn),
      ),
    );

    // بدء الحركة
    _controller.forward();

    // الانتقال بعد انتهاء الـ Splash
    _controller.addStatusListener((status) {
      if (status == AnimationStatus.completed) {
        _navigateToNextScreen();
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _navigateToNextScreen() async {
    // ⭐ SAFE FIX: الانتظار حتى استعادة الجلسة من التخزين بشكل مؤكد
    final user = await FirebaseAuth.instance.authStateChanges().first;
    
    if (user != null) {
       // (تم نقل تحميل الجروبات وصلاحيات الإشعار إلى MainNavigation لضمان الاستدعاء)
       
       Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        PageRouteBuilder(
          pageBuilder: (_, __, ___) => const MainNavigation(),
          transitionsBuilder: (_, animation, __, child) => FadeTransition(opacity: animation, child: child),
          transitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
        ),
      );
    } else {
      Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        PageRouteBuilder(
          pageBuilder: (_, __, ___) => const WelcomeScreen(),
          transitionsBuilder: (_, animation, __, child) => FadeTransition(opacity: animation, child: child),
          transitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0F7B6C), // لون هوية Jam3iya الأساسي
      body: Center(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            // الشعار مع تأثير التكبير والظهور
            FadeTransition(
              opacity: _fadeAnimation,
              child: ScaleTransition(
                scale: _scaleAnimation,
                child: Container(
                  width: 140,
                  height: 140,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    boxShadow: [
                      BoxShadow(
                        color: const Color(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.2), // Glow ذهبي خفيف واحترافي
                        blurRadius: 30,
                        spreadRadius: 5,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  child: ClipRRect(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(70),
                    child: Image.asset(
                      'assets/icons/app_icon.png',
                      fit: BoxFit.cover,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),
            // اسم التطبيق يظهر بـ Fade متأخر
            FadeTransition(
              opacity: _textFadeAnimation,
              child: const Text(
                "Jam3iya",
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 32,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  letterSpacing: 2.0,
                  color: Colors.white, // أبيض ليتناسب مع الخلفية الخضراء
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
