// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\screens\groups\create_group_screen.dart ---
// lib/screens/groups/create_group_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';

import '../../models/group_model.dart';
import '../../providers/group_provider.dart';

class CreateGroupScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const CreateGroupScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<CreateGroupScreen> createState() => _CreateGroupScreenState();
}

class _CreateGroupScreenState extends State<CreateGroupScreen> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();

  final nameController = TextEditingController();
  final amountController = TextEditingController();

  DateTime startDate = DateTime.now();
  DateTime endDate = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 180));

  final messageController = TextEditingController();
  TimeOfDay notificationTime = const TimeOfDay(hour: 9, minute: 0);

  bool isLoading = false;

  int get totalMonths {
    return (endDate.year - startDate.year) * 12 +
        (endDate.month - startDate.month) + 1;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final locale = context.locale; // Ensure translations update instantly
    final provider = context.read<GroupProvider>();
    final currentUid = provider.currentUserId;

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text("createGroup".tr())),
      body: SingleChildScrollView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Form(
          key: _formKey,
          child: Column(
            children: [
              TextFormField(
                controller: nameController,
                enabled: !isLoading,
                decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: "groupName".tr()),
                validator: (v) => v == null || v.trim().isEmpty ? "enterName".tr() : null,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              TextFormField(
                controller: amountController,
                enabled: !isLoading,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: "monthlyAmount".tr()),
                validator: (v) {
                  if (v == null || v.isEmpty) return "enterAmount".tr();
                  final parsed = int.tryParse(v);
                  if (parsed == null) return "invalidAmount".tr();
                  if (parsed <= 0) return "error_invalid_amount_positive".tr();
                  return null;
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
              ListTile(
                title: Text("startMonth".tr()),
                subtitle: Text("${startDate.month}/${startDate.year}"),
                trailing: const Icon(Icons.edit),
                onTap: isLoading ? null : () async {
                  final picked = await showDatePicker(
                    context: context,
                    initialDate: startDate,
                    firstDate: DateTime(2023),
                    lastDate: DateTime(2040),
                  );
                  if (picked != null) setState(() => startDate = picked);
                },
              ),
              ListTile(
                title: Text("endMonth".tr()),
                subtitle: Text("${endDate.month}/${endDate.year}"),
                trailing: const Icon(Icons.edit),
                onTap: isLoading ? null : () async {
                  final picked = await showDatePicker(
                    context: context,
                    initialDate: endDate,
                    firstDate: startDate,
                    lastDate: DateTime(2045),
                  );
                  if (picked != null) setState(() => endDate = picked);
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(
                "${"totalDuration".tr()}: $totalMonths ${"months".tr()}",
                style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
              TextFormField(
                controller: messageController,
                enabled: !isLoading,
                decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: "monthlyMessageOptional".tr()),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              ListTile(
                title: Text("notificationTime".tr()),
                subtitle: Text(notificationTime.format(context)),
                trailing: const Icon(Icons.access_time),
                onTap: isLoading ? null : () async {
                  final picked = await showTimePicker(
                    context: context,
                    initialTime: notificationTime,
                  );
                  if (picked != null) setState(() => notificationTime = picked);
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 32),
              SizedBox(
                width: double.infinity,
                child: ElevatedButton(
                  onPressed: isLoading ? null : () async {
                    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
                    
                    if (totalMonths <= 0) {
                      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                        SnackBar(content: Text("error_date_invalid".tr())),
                      );
                      return;
                    }

                    setState(() => isLoading = true);

                    try {
                      await provider.addGroup(
                        Group(
                          id: '',
                          name: nameController.text.trim(),
                          monthlyAmount: int.parse(amountController.text),
                          receiverName: "",
                          receiveDate: startDate,
                          startDate: startDate,
                          endDate: endDate,
                          isCompleted: false,
                          members: [currentUid],
                          pendingMembers: [],
                          receiverOrder: [currentUid],
                          myUserId: currentUid,
                          roles: {currentUid: GroupRole.leader},
                          payments: {},
                          paidMonths: [],
                          monthlyMessage: messageController.text.trim(),
                          notificationHour: notificationTime.hour,
                          notificationMinute: notificationTime.minute,
                        ),
                      );
                      if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context);
                    } catch (e) {
                      if (mounted) {
                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                          SnackBar(content: Text("error_generic".tr())),
                        );
                      }
                    } finally {
                      // ⭐ STRICT FIX: Guarantees loading ALWAYS stops if it didn't navigate away
                      if (mounted) setState(() => isLoading = false);
                    }
                  },
                  child: isLoading
                      ? const SizedBox(
                          height: 22, width: 22, 
                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: Colors.white))
                      : Text("createGroupButton".tr()),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\screens\groups\join_group_screen.dart ---
// lib/screens/groups/join_group_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';
import '../../providers/group_provider.dart';

class JoinGroupScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const JoinGroupScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<JoinGroupScreen> createState() => _JoinGroupScreenState();
}

class _JoinGroupScreenState extends State<JoinGroupScreen> {
  final codeController = TextEditingController();
  bool loading = false;

  Future<void> join() async {
    final code = codeController.text.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (code.isEmpty) return;

    setState(() => loading = true);

    final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
    final navigator = Navigator.of(context);
    final provider = context.read<GroupProvider>();

    try {
      await provider.joinGroup(code);
      // ⭐ FIX: Add missing mounted check before navigation
      if (!mounted) return;
      messenger.showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text("waiting_for_approval".tr())),
      );
      navigator.pop();
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;

      final error = e.toString();
      String message;

      if (error.contains("closed")) {
        message = "groupClosedJoin".tr();
      } else if (error.contains("already_member")) {
        message = "error_already_member".tr();
      } else if (error.contains("already_requested")) {
        message = "error_already_requested".tr();
      } else if (error.contains("not_found")) {
        message = "groupNotFound".tr();
      } else {
        message = "invalidCode".tr();
      }

      messenger.showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(message)));
      setState(() => loading = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text("joinGroup".tr())),
      body: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            const SizedBox(height: 40),
            TextField(
              controller: codeController,
              enabled: !loading,
              textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.characters,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                labelText: "groupCode".tr(),
                border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Text(
              "exampleCode".tr(),
              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 30),
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              child: ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: loading ? null : join,
                child: loading
                    ? const SizedBox(
                        height: 22, width: 22, 
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2))
                    : Text("joinGroup".tr()),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\screens\groups\my_groups_screen.dart ---
// lib/screens/groups/my_groups_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';
import 'create_group_screen.dart';
import '../../providers/group_provider.dart';
import '../../widgets/group_card.dart';
import 'group_details/group_details_screen.dart';
import '../../core/utils/group_intelligence.dart'; 

class MyGroupsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const MyGroupsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<MyGroupsScreen> createState() => _MyGroupsScreenState();
}

class _MyGroupsScreenState extends State<MyGroupsScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late TabController tabController;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    tabController = TabController(length: 2, vsync: this);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    tabController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final locale = context.locale; // ⭐ Dependency for language instant updates

    return Column(
      children: [
        TabBar(
          controller: tabController,
          indicatorColor: const Color(0xFF0F7B6C),
          indicatorWeight: 3,
          tabs: [
            Tab(text: "myGroups".tr()),
            Tab(text: "summary".tr())
          ],
        ),
        Expanded(
          child: TabBarView(
            controller: tabController,
            children: [
              buildGroupsTab(context),
              buildSummaryTab(context),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

 Widget buildGroupsTab(BuildContext context) {
    final allGroups = context.watch<GroupProvider>().groups;
    final active = allGroups.where((g) => !GroupIntelligence.isCompleted(g)).toList();

    return ListView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      children: [
        Text("currentGroups".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 16)),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        ...active.map((g) => Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
              child: GroupCard(
                group: g,
                showGroupDetails: true,
                onTap: () => Navigator.push(
                  context,
                  MaterialPageRoute(
                    builder: (_) => GroupDetailsScreen(group: g),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            )),
        if (active.isEmpty)
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 40),
            child: Center(child: Text("no_active_groups".tr())),
          ),
        const SizedBox(height: 30),
        ElevatedButton(
          onPressed: () {
            Navigator.push(
              context,
              MaterialPageRoute(
                builder: (_) => const CreateGroupScreen(),
              ),
            );
          },
          child: Text("createGroupButton".tr()),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 10),
        OutlinedButton(
          onPressed: () => _showJoinDialog(context),
          child: Text("joinGroup".tr()),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget buildSummaryTab(BuildContext context) {
    final allGroups = context.watch<GroupProvider>().groups;
    final activeGroups = allGroups.where((g) => !GroupIntelligence.isCompleted(g)).toList();

    if (activeGroups.isEmpty) {
      return Center(child: Text("no_active_groups".tr()));
    }

    return ListView.builder(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      itemCount: activeGroups.length,
      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
        final g = activeGroups[index];
        final receiveAmount = g.monthlyAmount * (g.receiverOrder.isNotEmpty ? g.receiverOrder.length : g.members.length);
        
        // Helper لدعم عرض الأشهر بشكل لائق
        String monthName(int m) {
          const names = ['', 'Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
          return names[m];
        }

        return Card(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  g.name,
                  style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 18, color: Color(0xFF1A1A1A)),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                Row(
                  children: [
                    const Icon(Icons.payments_outlined, size: 18, color: Colors.blue),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Text("₹${g.monthlyAmount} / ${'month'.tr()}", style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w500)),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Row(
                  children: [
                    const Icon(Icons.calendar_today_outlined, size: 18, color: Colors.grey),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Text(
                      "${monthName(g.startDate.month)} ${g.startDate.year} → ${monthName(g.endDate.month)} ${g.endDate.year}",
                      style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.black87),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                const Divider(),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Text("${'youWillReceive'.tr()}: ", style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w500)),
                    Text(
                      "₹$receiveAmount",
                      style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color(0xFFD4AF37), fontSize: 16),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  void _showJoinDialog(BuildContext context) {
    final controller = TextEditingController();

    showDialog(
      barrierDismissible: false,
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) {
        bool loading = false;

        return StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (context, setState) {
            return AlertDialog(
              title: Text("joinGroup".tr()),
              content: TextField(
                controller: controller,
                enabled: !loading,
                textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.characters,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: "enter_group_code".tr(),
                ),
              ),
              actions: [
                TextButton(
                  onPressed:
                      loading ? null : () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
                  child: Text("cancel".tr()),
                ),
                ElevatedButton(
                  onPressed: loading
                      ? null
                      : () async {
                          final code = controller.text.trim().toUpperCase();
                          if (code.isEmpty) return;

                          setState(() => loading = true);
                          final provider = context.read<GroupProvider>();
                          
                          final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
                          final navigator = Navigator.of(dialogContext);

                          try {
                            await provider.joinGroup(code);
                            if (!context.mounted) return;
                            navigator.pop();
                            messenger.showSnackBar(
                              SnackBar(content: Text("waiting_for_approval".tr())),
                            );
                          } catch (e) {
                            if (!context.mounted) return;
                            setState(() => loading = false);

                            final error = e.toString();
                            String message;

                            if (error.contains("closed")) {
                              message = "groupClosedJoin".tr();
                            } else if (error.contains("already_member")) {
                              message = "error_already_member".tr();
                            } else if (error.contains("already_requested")) {
                              message = "error_already_requested".tr();
                            } else if (error.contains("not_found")) {
                              message = "groupNotFound".tr();
                            } else {
                              message = "invalidCode".tr();
                            }

                            messenger.showSnackBar(
                              SnackBar(content: Text(message)),
                            );
                          }
                        },
                  child: loading
                      ? const SizedBox(
                          height: 18,
                          width: 18,
                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                        )
                      : Text("join".tr()),
                ),
              ],
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

// lib/screens/groups/group_details/chat_tab.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:jam3iya_app/core/config/feature_flags.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';
import '../../../models/group_model.dart';
import '../../../models/message_model.dart';
import '../../../providers/chat_provider.dart';
import '../../../providers/group_provider.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';

class ChatTab extends StatefulWidget {
  final Group group;
  const ChatTab({super.key, required this.group});

  @override
  State<ChatTab> createState() => _ChatTabState();
}

class _ChatTabState extends State<ChatTab> {
  final TextEditingController _controller = TextEditingController();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final chatProvider = context.read<ChatProvider>();
    final groupProvider = context.read<GroupProvider>();
    final myUid = groupProvider.currentUserId;
    
    final bool isLeadersOnly = widget.group.chatMode == 'leaders_only';
    final bool canChat = !isLeadersOnly || widget.group.canManage;

    return Column(
      children: [
        if (isLeadersOnly)
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
            width: double.infinity,
            color: Colors.orange.withOpacity(0.1),
            child: Text(
              "chat_locked_msg".tr(), // 🌐 مترجم
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.orange, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 12),
            ),
          ),
        Expanded(
          child: StreamBuilder<List<Message>>(
            stream: chatProvider.watchMessages(widget.group.id),
            builder: (context, snapshot) {
              if (snapshot.hasError) return Center(child: Text("error_loading_chat".tr())); // 🌐 مترجم
              if (!snapshot.hasData) return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());

              final messages = snapshot.data!;
              if (messages.isEmpty) {
                return Center(child: Text("no_messages_yet".tr(), style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey.shade600))); // 🌐 مترجم
              }

              return ListView.builder(
                reverse: true,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                itemCount: messages.length,
                itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                  final msg = messages[index];
                  final isMe = msg.senderId == myUid;

                  // ⭐ تغليف فقاعة الشات بـ GestureDetector للضغط المطول
                  return Align(
                    alignment: isMe ? Alignment.centerRight : Alignment.centerLeft,
                    child: GestureDetector(
                      onLongPress: msg.isDeleted ? null : () {
                        // 1. حساب الصلاحيات (Moderation Logic)
                        final bool canDelete = isMe || widget.group.canManage;
                        final bool hasText = msg.text.isNotEmpty;

                        // 2. إخفاء القائمة تماماً إذا لم يكن لديه أي صلاحية على هذه الرسالة
                        if (!canDelete && !hasText) return; 

                        // 3. عرض قائمة WhatsApp-Style
                        showModalBottomSheet(
                          context: context,
                          shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(16))),
                          builder: (sheetContext) {
                            return SafeArea(
                              child: Wrap(
                                children: [
                                  if (hasText)
                                    ListTile(
                                      leading: const Icon(Icons.copy, color: Colors.blue),
                                      title: Text("copy_message".tr()),
                                      onTap: () {
                                        Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: msg.text));
                                        Navigator.pop(sheetContext);
                                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text("message_copied".tr())));
                                      },
                                    ),
                                  if (canDelete)
                                    ListTile(
                                      leading: const Icon(Icons.delete, color: Colors.red),
                                      title: Text("delete_message".tr(), style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
                                      onTap: () async {
                                        Navigator.pop(sheetContext); // إغلاق الـ Bottom Sheet
                                        // تأكيد الحذف
                                        final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
                                          context: context,
                                          builder: (_) => AlertDialog(
                                            title: Text("delete_message".tr()),
                                            content: Text("delete_message_confirm".tr()),
                                            actions: [
                                              TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false), child: Text("cancel".tr())),
                                              ElevatedButton(
                                                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: Colors.red),
                                                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true), 
                                                child: Text("delete".tr()),
                                              ),
                                            ],
                                          ),
                                        );
                                        if (confirm == true) {
                                          chatProvider.softDeleteMessage(groupId: widget.group.id, messageId: msg.id, uid: myUid);
                                        }
                                      },
                                    ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            );
                          },
                        );
                      },
                      child: Container(
                        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                        constraints: BoxConstraints(maxWidth: MediaQuery.of(context).size.width * 0.75),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 10),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: isMe ? const Color(0xFF0F7B6C) : Colors.white,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
                            topLeft: const Radius.circular(16),
                            topRight: const Radius.circular(16),
                            bottomLeft: isMe ? const Radius.circular(16) : Radius.zero,
                            bottomRight: isMe ? Radius.zero : const Radius.circular(16),
                          ),
                          boxShadow: [BoxShadow(color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.05), blurRadius: 4, offset: const Offset(0, 2))],
                        ),
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            if (!isMe)
                              Text(
                                msg.senderName,
                                style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 12, color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C)),
                              ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 4),

                            // ⭐ المنطق الجديد لعرض الرسالة (WhatsApp Style)
                            if (msg.isDeleted)
                              Row(
                                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                children: [
                                  Icon(Icons.do_not_disturb_alt, size: 14, color: isMe ? Colors.white70 : Colors.grey.shade500),
                                  const SizedBox(width: 4),
                                  Text(
                                    "message_deleted".tr(),
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                      color: isMe ? Colors.white70 : Colors.grey.shade500, 
                                      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, 
                                      fontSize: 14
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              )
                            else if (FeatureFlags.imageFeaturesEnabled && msg.imageUrl.isNotEmpty)
                              GestureDetector(
                                onTap: () => showDialog(
                                  context: context,
                                  builder: (_) => Dialog(backgroundColor: Colors.transparent, child: InteractiveViewer(child: Image.network(msg.imageUrl))),
                                ),
                                child: ClipRRect(
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                    child: Image.network(msg.imageUrl, height: 150, fit: BoxFit.cover),
                                ),
                              )
                            else
                              Text(
                                msg.text,
                                style: TextStyle(color: isMe ? Colors.white : const Color(0xFF1A1A1A), fontSize: 15),
                              ),
                              
                            const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Align(
                              alignment: Alignment.bottomRight,
                              child: Text(
                                DateFormat.Hm(context.locale.toString()).format(msg.createdAt),
                                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: isMe ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black45),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ), // إغلاق الـ Column
                      ), // إغلاق الـ Container
                    ), // ⭐✅ هذا هو قوس الـ GestureDetector الذي كان مفقوداً!
                  ); // إغلاق الـ Align
                },
              ); // إغلاق الـ ListView.builder
            },
          ),
        ),
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: Colors.white,
            boxShadow: [BoxShadow(color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.05), blurRadius: 10, offset: const Offset(0, -2))],
          ),
          child: SafeArea(
            child: Row(
             children: [
                // ⭐ زر رفع الصورة (مجمد تماماً عبر Feature Flag)
                if (FeatureFlags.imageFeaturesEnabled && (widget.group.isLeader || widget.group.allowMemberImageMessages))
                  IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.add_photo_alternate, color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C)),
                    onPressed: canChat ? () async {
                     final picker = ImagePicker();
                      // ⭐ PERFORMANCE FIX: تصغير الأبعاد والضغط لمنع الـ RAM Overload والـ UI Freeze
                      final picked = await picker.pickImage(
                        source: ImageSource.gallery, 
                        imageQuality: 50, // ضغط أعلى
                        maxWidth: 1024,   // منع الصور الضخمة (4K)
                        maxHeight: 1024,
                      );
                      if (picked != null && context.mounted) {
                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text("sending...".tr())));
                        final myName = groupProvider.getUserName(myUid) ?? "User";
                        await chatProvider.sendImageMessage(widget.group.id, File(picked.path), myName);
                      }
                    } : null,
                  ),
                Expanded(
                  child: TextField(
                    controller: _controller,
                    enabled: canChat,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      hintText: canChat ? "type_message".tr() : "chat_locked_hint".tr(), // 🌐 مترجم
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
                        borderSide: BorderSide.none,
                      ),
                      filled: true,
                      fillColor: const Color(0xFFF6F8F7),
                      contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 10),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                CircleAvatar(
                  backgroundColor: canChat ? const Color(0xFF0F7B6C) : Colors.grey,
                  radius: 24,
                  child: IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.send, color: Colors.white, size: 20),
                    onPressed: canChat ? () {
                      final text = _controller.text;
                      if (text.trim().isNotEmpty) {
                         final myName = groupProvider.getUserName(myUid) ?? "User";
                         chatProvider.sendMessage(widget.group.id, text, myName);
                        _controller.clear();
                      }
                    } : null,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\screens\groups\group_details\group_details_screen.dart ---
// lib/screens/groups/group_details/group_details_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';
import 'package:jam3iya_app/screens/groups/group_details/chat_tab.dart';
import '../../../models/group_model.dart';
import 'overview_tab.dart';
import 'schedule_tab.dart';
import 'payments_tab.dart';
import 'members_tab.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../../../providers/group_provider.dart';
import 'manage_tab.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/group_intelligence.dart';

class GroupDetailsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final Group group;

  const GroupDetailsScreen({super.key, required this.group});

  @override
  State<GroupDetailsScreen> createState() => _GroupDetailsScreenState();
}

class _GroupDetailsScreenState extends State<GroupDetailsScreen> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    // ⭐ SAFE FIX #2: تحميل أسماء جميع الأعضاء مسبقاً قبل عرض الشاشات
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted) {
        final provider = context.read<GroupProvider>();
        final g = provider.getGroup(widget.group.id) ?? widget.group;
        final allUids = [...g.members, ...g.pendingMembers, ...g.receiverOrder];
        provider.preloadUserNames(allUids.toSet().toList());
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Consumer<GroupProvider>(
      builder: (context, provider, _) {
        final updatedGroup = provider.getGroup(widget.group.id);

        if (updatedGroup == null) {
          return Scaffold(
            appBar: AppBar(elevation: 0, backgroundColor: Colors.white),
            body: Center(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  const Text("Group data unavailable or deleted."),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  ElevatedButton(
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                    child: const Text("Go Back"),
                  )
                ],
              ),
            ),
          );
        }

        if (updatedGroup.pendingMembers.contains(updatedGroup.myUserId)) {
          return Scaffold(
            appBar: AppBar(
              elevation: 0,
              backgroundColor: Colors.white,
              title: Text(updatedGroup.name),
            ),
            body: Center(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                child: Text(
                  "waiting_for_approval".tr(),
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 16,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }

        return DefaultTabController(
          length: 5,
          child: Scaffold(
            appBar: AppBar(
              elevation: 0,
              backgroundColor: Colors.white,
              title: Text(
                updatedGroup.name,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: Color(0xFF1A1A1A),
                ),
              ),
              actions: [
                // منع الدخول للإدارة إذا انتهت الجمعية
                if (updatedGroup.canManage &&
                    !GroupIntelligence.isCompleted(updatedGroup))
                  IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.settings, color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C)),
                    onPressed: () {
                      Navigator.push(
                        context,
                        MaterialPageRoute(
                          builder: (_) => ManageTab(group: updatedGroup),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
              ],
              bottom: TabBar(
                isScrollable: true,
                indicatorColor: const Color(0xFF0F7B6C),
                indicatorWeight: 3,
                labelColor: const Color(0xFF0F7B6C),
                unselectedLabelColor: Colors.grey,
                labelStyle: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                tabs: [
                  Tab(text: "overview".tr()),
                  Tab(text: "schedule".tr()),
                  // ⭐ نقل تبويب الشات ليكون الثالث
                  Tab(
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: [
                        const Icon(Icons.chat_bubble_outline, size: 18),
                        const SizedBox(width: 4),
                        Text("chat_tab_title".tr()), // 🌐 مترجم
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  Tab(
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: [
                        Text("payments".tr()),
                        if (updatedGroup.canManage &&
                            updatedGroup.pendingPaymentsCount > 0)
                          Container(
                            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 6),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: const Color(0xFFD32F2F),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            ),
                            child: Text(
                              updatedGroup.pendingPaymentsCount.toString(),
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.white,
                                fontSize: 12,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  Tab(
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: [
                        Text("members".tr()),
                        if (updatedGroup.pendingMembers.isNotEmpty &&
                            updatedGroup.canManage)
                          Container(
                            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 6),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: const Color(0xFFD32F2F),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            ),
                            child: Text(
                              updatedGroup.pendingMembers.length.toString(),
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.white,
                                fontSize: 12,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            body: TabBarView(
              children: [
                OverviewTab(group: updatedGroup),
                ScheduleTab(group: updatedGroup),
                ChatTab(group: updatedGroup),
                PaymentsTab(group: updatedGroup),
                MembersTab(group: updatedGroup),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\screens\groups\group_details\manage_tab.dart ---
// lib/screens/groups/group_details/manage_tab.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:jam3iya_app/core/config/feature_flags.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';
import '../../../models/group_model.dart';
import '../../../providers/group_provider.dart';
import '../../../widgets/user_name_text.dart';
import '../../../providers/chat_provider.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';

class ManageTab extends StatefulWidget {
  final Group group;
  const ManageTab({super.key, required this.group});

  @override
  State<ManageTab> createState() => _ManageTabState();
}

class _ManageTabState extends State<ManageTab> {
  late DateTime startDate;
  late DateTime endDate;
  late List<String> receiverOrder;
  late TextEditingController messageController;
  late TimeOfDay notificationTime;
  
  bool isSaving = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    startDate = widget.group.startDate;
    endDate = widget.group.endDate;
    receiverOrder = widget.group.receiverOrder.isNotEmpty
        ? List<String>.from(widget.group.receiverOrder)
        : List<String>.from(widget.group.members);
        
    for (final m in widget.group.members) {
      if (!receiverOrder.contains(m)) receiverOrder.add(m);
    }

    messageController = TextEditingController(text: widget.group.monthlyMessage);
    notificationTime = TimeOfDay(hour: widget.group.notificationHour, minute: widget.group.notificationMinute);
  }

  void _confirmDelete(BuildContext context) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (dialogContext) {
        bool isDeleting = false;
        return StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (context, setDialogState) {
            return AlertDialog(
              title: Text("deleteGroup".tr()),
              content: Text("deleteGroupWarning".tr()),
              actions: [
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: isDeleting ? null : () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
                  child: Text("cancel".tr()),
                ),
                ElevatedButton(
                  style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: Colors.red),
                  onPressed: isDeleting ? null : () async {
                    setDialogState(() => isDeleting = true);
                    try {
                      await this.context.read<GroupProvider>().deleteGroup(widget.group);
                      if (dialogContext.mounted) Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
                      if (this.context.mounted) Navigator.of(this.context).popUntil((route) => route.isFirst);
                    } catch (e) {
                      if (dialogContext.mounted) setDialogState(() => isDeleting = false);
                      if (this.context.mounted) {
                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(this.context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text("error_generic".tr())));
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  child: isDeleting 
                      ? const SizedBox(height: 16, width: 16, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: Colors.white))
                      : Text("delete".tr()),
                ),
              ],
            );
          }
        );
      },
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (widget.group.isClosed) {
      return Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: Text("manageGroup".tr())),
        body: Center(
          child: Text(
            "groupClosedEditingDisabled".tr(),
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text("manageGroup".tr())),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: [
          Text("editStartDate".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
          ListTile(
            title: Text("${startDate.month}/${startDate.year}"),
            trailing: const Icon(Icons.edit),
            onTap: isSaving ? null : () async {
              final picked = await showDatePicker(
                context: context,
                initialDate: startDate,
                firstDate: DateTime(2020),
                lastDate: DateTime(2035),
              );
              if (picked != null) setState(() => startDate = picked);
            },
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          Text("editEndDate".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
          ListTile(
            title: Text("${endDate.month}/${endDate.year}"),
            trailing: const Icon(Icons.edit),
            onTap: isSaving ? null : () async {
              final picked = await showDatePicker(
                context: context,
                initialDate: endDate,
                firstDate: startDate,
                lastDate: DateTime(2040),
              );
              if (picked != null) setState(() => endDate = picked);
            },
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 30),
          Text("receiverOrder".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: isSaving ? null : () => setState(() => receiverOrder.shuffle()),
            child: Text("randomOrder".tr()),
          ),
          
          // ⭐ تحسين UX إعادة الترتيب: يمكن سحب الصف بأكمله
          ReorderableListView.builder(
            shrinkWrap: true,
            physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
            buildDefaultDragHandles: false,
            itemCount: receiverOrder.length,
            onReorder: (oldIndex, newIndex) {
              setState(() {
                if (newIndex > oldIndex) newIndex--;
                final item = receiverOrder.removeAt(oldIndex);
                receiverOrder.insert(newIndex, item);
              });
            },
            itemBuilder: (context, index) {
              final uid = receiverOrder[index];
              return ReorderableDragStartListener(
                key: ValueKey(uid),
                index: index,
                child: Material(
                  color: Colors.transparent, 
                  child: ListTile(
                    title: UserNameText(uid: uid),
                    leading: const Icon(Icons.drag_indicator, color: Colors.grey),
                  ),
                ),
              );
            },
          ),

          if (!widget.group.distributionStarted)
            ElevatedButton(
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: Colors.green),
              onPressed: isSaving ? null : () async {
                final confirm = await showDialog(
                  context: context,
                  builder: (_) => AlertDialog(
                    title: Text("startDistribution".tr()),
                    content: Text("startDistributionConfirm".tr()),
                    actions: [
                      TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false), child: Text("cancel".tr())),
                      ElevatedButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true), child: Text("confirm".tr())),
                    ],
                  ),
                );
                if (confirm != true || !mounted) return;
                
                setState(() => isSaving = true);
                try {
                  await context.read<GroupProvider>().startDistribution(widget.group);
                  if (mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text("distributionStarted".tr())));
                  if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context);
                } catch (e) {
                  if (mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text("error_generic".tr())));
                } finally {
                  if (mounted) setState(() => isSaving = false);
                }
              },
              child: Text("startDistribution".tr()),
            ),
            // ⭐ إعدادات الشات (Mute Control) مع الترجمة والمزامنة اللحظية
         if (widget.group.myRole == GroupRole.leader)
            Consumer<GroupProvider>(
              builder: (context, groupProvider, _) {
                // جلب النسخة المحدثة لحظياً من الجروب
                final currentGroup = groupProvider.getGroup(widget.group.id) ?? widget.group;
                
                // ⭐ التغليف الصحيح بـ Column
                return Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    SwitchListTile(
                      title: Text("lock_chat_title".tr()), 
                      subtitle: Text("lock_chat_subtitle".tr()), 
                      value: currentGroup.chatMode == 'leaders_only', 
                      activeColor: const Color(0xFF0F7B6C),
                      onChanged: (bool value) async {
                        final newMode = value ? 'leaders_only' : 'all_members';
                        await context.read<ChatProvider>().updateChatMode(widget.group.id, newMode);
                        if (mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text("chat_mode_updated".tr()))); 
                      },
                    ),
                    // ⭐ مفتاح تحكم القائد في صور الأعضاء (مجمد مؤقتاً)
                    if (FeatureFlags.imageFeaturesEnabled)
                      SwitchListTile(
                        title: Text("allow_member_images".tr()), 
                        subtitle: Text("allow_member_images_desc".tr()),
                        value: currentGroup.allowMemberImageMessages,
                      activeColor: const Color(0xFF0F7B6C),
                      onChanged: (bool value) async {
                        await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('groups').doc(widget.group.id).update({
                          'allowMemberImageMessages': value,
                        });
                      },
                    ),
                  ],
                ); // ⭐ إغلاق الـ Column
              },
            ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          TextFormField(
            controller: messageController,
            enabled: !isSaving,
            decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: "monthlyMessageOptional".tr()),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          ListTile(
            title: Text("notificationTime".tr()),
            subtitle: Text(notificationTime.format(context)),
            trailing: const Icon(Icons.access_time),
            onTap: isSaving ? null : () async {
              final picked = await showTimePicker(context: context, initialTime: notificationTime);
              if (picked != null) setState(() => notificationTime = picked);
            },
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 30),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: isSaving ? null : () async {
              setState(() => isSaving = true);
              try {
                await context.read<GroupProvider>().updateGroupSettings(
                  widget.group, startDate, endDate, receiverOrder,
                  messageController.text.trim(), notificationTime.hour, notificationTime.minute,
                );
                if (mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text("settingsUpdated".tr())));
              } catch (_) {
                if (mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text("error_generic".tr())));
              } finally {
                if (mounted) setState(() => isSaving = false);
              }
            },
            child: isSaving 
                ? const SizedBox(height: 22, width: 22, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: Colors.white)) 
                : Text("saveChanges".tr()),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 30),
          ElevatedButton(
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: Colors.red),
            onPressed: isSaving ? null : () => _confirmDelete(context),
            child: Text("deleteGroup".tr()),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\screens\groups\group_details\members_tab.dart ---
// lib/screens/groups/group_details/members_tab.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';
import '../../../models/group_model.dart';
import '../../../providers/group_provider.dart';
import '../../../widgets/user_name_text.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/group_intelligence.dart';

class MembersTab extends StatelessWidget {
  final Group group;

  const MembersTab({super.key, required this.group});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      color: const Color(0xFFF6F8F7),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          if (group.pendingMembers.isNotEmpty && group.canManage)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
              child: ExpansionTile(
                tilePadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4),
                childrenPadding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                title: Text(
                  "pending_requests".tr(args: [group.pendingMembers.length.toString()]),
                  style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                ),
                leading: const Icon(Icons.person_add),
                children: group.pendingMembers.map((uid) {
                  return Container(
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                    child: Material(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      elevation: 1,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      child: Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                        child: Row(
                          children: [
                            Expanded(child: UserNameText(uid: uid)),
                            IconButton(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.close, color: Colors.red),
                              onPressed: () => context.read<GroupProvider>().rejectMember(group, uid),
                            ),
                            IconButton(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.check, color: Colors.green),
                              onPressed: () => context.read<GroupProvider>().approveMember(group, uid),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                }).toList(),
              ),
            ),
          Expanded(
            child: ListView.builder(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              itemCount: group.members.length,
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                final uid = group.members[index];
                final isMe = uid == group.myUserId;
                final targetRole = group.roles[uid] ?? GroupRole.member;
                final myRole = group.myRole;

                String roleText = "member".tr();
                if (targetRole == GroupRole.leader) roleText = "leader".tr();
                else if (targetRole == GroupRole.assistant) roleText = "assistant".tr();

                // ⭐ ضبط صارم لصلاحيات واجهة الإدارة وتجميدها في الأرشيف
                final isCompleted = GroupIntelligence.isCompleted(group);
                bool canShowMenu = false;
                List<PopupMenuEntry<String>> menuItems = [];

                // إخفاء خيارات الإدارة تماماً إذا انتهت الجمعية
                if (!isMe && !isCompleted) {
                  if (myRole == GroupRole.leader) {
                     canShowMenu = true;
                     if (targetRole != GroupRole.assistant) {
                        menuItems.add(PopupMenuItem(value: "assistant", child: Text("make_assistant".tr())));
                     }
                     if (targetRole == GroupRole.assistant) {
                        menuItems.add(PopupMenuItem(value: "member", child: Text("make_member".tr())));
                     }
                     menuItems.add(PopupMenuItem(value: "remove", child: Text("remove_member".tr())));

                  } else if (myRole == GroupRole.assistant) {
                     // المساعد يستطيع الإدارة على الأعضاء فقط (يُمنع عند القائد والمساعدين الآخرين)
                     if (targetRole == GroupRole.member) {
                        canShowMenu = true;
                        menuItems.add(PopupMenuItem(value: "remove", child: Text("remove_member".tr())));
                     }
                  }
                }

                return Container(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                  child: Material(
                    color: Colors.white,
                    elevation: 1,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                      child: Row(
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: const Color(0xFF0F7B6C).withValues(alpha: 0.08),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            ),
                            child: const Icon(Icons.person, color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C)),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 14),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: [
                                Row(
                                  children: [
                                    Flexible(child: UserNameText(uid: uid)),
                                    if (isMe)
                                      Text(
                                        "you_label".tr(),
                                        style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF6B6B6B)),
                                      ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                                Text(roleText, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Color(0xFF6B6B6B))),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                          if (targetRole == GroupRole.leader) const Icon(Icons.emoji_events, color: Color(0xFFD4AF37)),
                          if (canShowMenu && menuItems.isNotEmpty)
                            PopupMenuButton<String>(
                              onSelected: (value) {
                                final provider = context.read<GroupProvider>();
                                if (value == "assistant") {
                                  provider.makeAssistant(groupId: group.id, memberId: uid);
                                } else if (value == "member") {
                                  provider.makeMember(groupId: group.id, memberId: uid);
                                } else if (value == "remove") {
                                  // السجل المالي السابق لا يمنع الحذف الإداري
                                  provider.removeMember(groupId: group.id, memberId: uid);
                                }
                              },
                              itemBuilder: (context) => menuItems,
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\screens\groups\group_details\overview_tab.dart ---
// lib/screens/groups/group_details/overview_tab.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import 'package:jam3iya_app/core/config/feature_flags.dart';

import '../../../widgets/user_name_text.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/group_intelligence.dart';
import '../../../models/group_model.dart';

import 'dart:io';
import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../../../providers/group_provider.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';

class OverviewTab extends StatelessWidget {
  final Group group;

  const OverviewTab({
    super.key,
    required this.group,
  });

Widget _basicInfoSection(BuildContext context, int membersCount) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        // ⭐ دائرة الصورة العلوية (مجمدة مؤقتاً)
        if (FeatureFlags.imageFeaturesEnabled)
          Center(
            child: GestureDetector(
              // ⭐ ميزة إضافية: حذف الصورة عند الضغط المطول للقائد
              onLongPress: group.isLeader && group.paymentQrUrl.isNotEmpty ? () async {
               await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('groups').doc(group.id).update({'paymentQrUrl': ''});
               ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text("Image deleted".tr())));
            } : null,
            onTap: () async {
              if (group.isLeader) { // ⭐ STRICT FIX: القائد فقط من يرفع أو يغير الصورة
                // 1) Leader Only: Upload or Change
                final picker = ImagePicker();
                // ⭐ PERFORMANCE FIX: كود خفيف وسريع لصورة الـ Overview
                final picked = await picker.pickImage(
                  source: ImageSource.gallery, 
                  imageQuality: 50,
                  maxWidth: 800, // صور הـ QR لا تحتاج دقة هائلة
                  maxHeight: 800,
                );
                if (picked != null && context.mounted) {
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text("uploading...".tr())));
                  // تمرير الرابط القديم لدالة الرفع
                  await context.read<GroupProvider>().updateGroupOverviewImage(group.id, File(picked.path), group.paymentQrUrl);
                }
              } else if (group.paymentQrUrl.isNotEmpty) {
                // 2) Member: View Full Screen (Simple Dialog)
                showDialog(
                  context: context,
                  builder: (_) => Dialog(
                    backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
                    child: InteractiveViewer(child: Image.network(group.paymentQrUrl)),
                  ),
                );
              }
            },
            child: Container(
              width: 100,
              height: 100,
              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 20),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                color: Colors.white,
                boxShadow: [BoxShadow(color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.1), blurRadius: 10)],
              ),
              child: ClipOval(
                child: group.paymentQrUrl.isNotEmpty
                    ? Image.network(group.paymentQrUrl, fit: BoxFit.cover)
                    : const Icon(Icons.qr_code, size: 40, color: Colors.grey), // Placeholder
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        Text(group.name, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),
        Row(
          children: [
            const Icon(Icons.qr_code, size: 18),
            const SizedBox(width: 6),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                "${"code".tr()}: ${group.groupCode}",
                style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, letterSpacing: 1.2),
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              ),
            ),
            IconButton(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.copy, size: 18),
              onPressed: () {
                Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: group.groupCode));
                ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text("codeCopied".tr())));
              },
            )
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),
        Text("₹${group.monthlyAmount} / ${"month".tr()}"),
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        const Divider(),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        Text("leader".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14)),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        if (group.members.isNotEmpty)
          UserNameText(uid: group.members.first, prefix: "👑 ", style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600))
        else
          const Text("—", style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        Text("members".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14)),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        Text("👥 $membersCount ${"members".tr()}", style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        Text("startDate".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14)),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        Text("📅 ${group.startDate.month}/${group.startDate.year}", style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        Text("endDate".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14)),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        Text("🏁 ${group.endDate.month}/${group.endDate.year}", style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        const Divider(),
      ],
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isCompleted = GroupIntelligence.isCompleted(group);
    final order = group.receiverOrder.isNotEmpty ? group.receiverOrder : group.members;
    final membersCount = order.length;

    // 🚨 التحول إلى وضع الأرشيف (Final Report) عند الانتهاء
    if (isCompleted) {
      final receiveAmount = group.monthlyAmount * membersCount;
      return Container(
        color: const Color(0xFFF6F8F7),
        child: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          children: [
            const Center(child: Icon(Icons.verified, color: Colors.grey, size: 60)),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            const Center(child: Text("Group Completed", style: TextStyle(fontSize: 22, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.grey))),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),
            _basicInfoSection(context, membersCount),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Card(
              child: ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.monetization_on, color: Color(0xFFD4AF37)),
                title: Text("totalReceiving".tr()),
                trailing: Text("₹$receiveAmount", style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 18, color: Color(0xFFD4AF37))),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    if (!group.distributionStarted) {
      return ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: [
          _basicInfoSection(context, group.members.length),
          const SizedBox(height: 24),
          Center(
            child: Text(
              "waitingLeaderDistribution".tr(),
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      );
    }

    final total = GroupIntelligence.totalMonths(group);
    final passed = GroupIntelligence.passedMonths(group); // ⭐ SAFE FIX: توحيد مصدر الحساب مع الـ Progress Bar
    final progress = GroupIntelligence.progress(group);

    if (order.isEmpty) return Center(child: Text("noMembersYet".tr()));

    final currentIndex = GroupIntelligence.currentReceiverIndex(group, membersCount);
    if (currentIndex == -1) {
      return ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: [
          _basicInfoSection(context, membersCount),
          const SizedBox(height: 24),
          Center(
            child: Text(
              "groupNotStarted".tr(),
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.orange),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      );
    }

    final nextIndex = GroupIntelligence.nextReceiverIndex(group, membersCount);
    final currentReceiver = order[currentIndex];
    final hasNextReceiver = nextIndex != -1;
    final nextReceiver = hasNextReceiver ? order[nextIndex] : "";

    final isMeCurrent = currentReceiver == group.myUserId;
    final isMeNext = hasNextReceiver && (nextReceiver == group.myUserId);

    return Container(
      color: const Color(0xFFF6F8F7),
      child: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: [
          _basicInfoSection(context, membersCount),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Text("currentReceiver".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14)),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          // ⭐ SAFE FIX #4: التوافق مع منطق عرض الكرت
          if (isMeCurrent)
             Text("your_turn".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.green, fontSize: 16))
          else
             UserNameText(uid: currentReceiver, prefix: "👤 ", suffix: "   ✅", style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
          
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Text("nextReceiver".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14)),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          if (!hasNextReceiver)
             Text("jam3iya_completed_status".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.grey, fontSize: 15))
          else if (isMeNext)
             Text("your_turn_n".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.green, fontSize: 16))
          else
             UserNameText(uid: nextReceiver, prefix: "👤 ", style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
             
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Text("yourTurn".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14)),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          Builder(
            builder: (_) {
              final myIndex = order.indexOf(group.myUserId);
              if (myIndex == -1) return const SizedBox();

              int monthsUntilTurn;
              if (currentIndex <= myIndex) {
                monthsUntilTurn = myIndex - currentIndex;
              } else {
                monthsUntilTurn = order.length - (currentIndex - myIndex);
              }

              final myReceiveDate = DateTime(group.startDate.year, group.startDate.month + currentIndex + monthsUntilTurn);
              final formattedMonth = DateFormat.yMMM(context.locale.toString()).format(myReceiveDate);

              return Text(
                "⭐ $formattedMonth",
                style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color(0xFFD4AF37)),
              );
            },
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          LinearProgressIndicator(
            value: progress,
            minHeight: 10,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
            backgroundColor: Colors.grey.shade200,
            valueColor: const AlwaysStoppedAnimation(Color(0xFF0F7B6C)),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text("$passed / $total ${"months".tr()}"),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Row(
            children: [
              Text("${"status".tr()}: "),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: group.isClosed ? const Color(0xFFD32F2F).withOpacity(0.15) : const Color(0xFF2E7D32).withOpacity(0.15),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  group.isClosed ? "closed".tr() : "active".tr(),
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: group.isClosed ? const Color(0xFFD32F2F) : const Color(0xFF2E7D32),
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 30),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\screens\groups\group_details\payments_tab.dart ---
// lib/screens/groups/group_details/payments_tab.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';
import 'payment_month_screen.dart';
import '../../../models/group_model.dart';
import '../../../providers/group_provider.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/group_intelligence.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

class PaymentsTab extends StatelessWidget {
  final Group group;

  const PaymentsTab({super.key, required this.group});

  List<DateTime> _generateMonths(Group g) {
    final total = GroupIntelligence.totalMonths(g);
    return List.generate(
      total,
      (i) => DateTime(g.startDate.year, g.startDate.month + i),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Consumer<GroupProvider>(
      builder: (context, provider, _) {
        final updatedGroup = provider.getGroup(group.id);
        if (updatedGroup == null) return const SizedBox();

        if (updatedGroup.isClosed) {
          return Center(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: Text(
                "group_closed_payments_disabled".tr(),
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }

        if (!updatedGroup.distributionStarted) {
          return Center(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: Text(
                "waitingLeaderDistribution".tr(),
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.orange, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 16),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }

        final months = _generateMonths(updatedGroup);
        final now = DateTime.now();
        final currentMonth = DateTime(now.year, now.month);

        return ListView.builder(
          itemCount: months.length,
          itemBuilder: (context, index) {
            final month = months[index];
            final key = Group.generateMonthKey(month);

            final paidList = updatedGroup.payments[key] ?? [];
            final isPaid = paidList.contains(updatedGroup.myUserId);
            final allPaid = updatedGroup.members.isNotEmpty && updatedGroup.members.every((m) => paidList.contains(m));
            final pendingKey = "${key}_pending";
            final requested = updatedGroup.payments[pendingKey]?.contains(updatedGroup.myUserId) ?? false;

            IconData icon;
            String label;
            VoidCallback? action;

            final monthDate = DateTime(month.year, month.month);
            final isCompleted = GroupIntelligence.isCompleted(updatedGroup);
            
            // ⭐ SAFE FIX #1: منطق حالات الأشهر المتوافق مع الاستخدام الواقعي

            if (isCompleted) {
              action = null; // تجميد الأزرار في وضع الأرشيف
              if (isPaid) {
                icon = Icons.check_circle;
                label = "paid".tr();
              } else {
                icon = Icons.lock;
                label = "locked".tr();
              }
            } else if (allPaid) {
              icon = Icons.check_circle;
              label = "paid".tr();
            } else if (monthDate.isAfter(currentMonth)) {
              // الأشهر المستقبلية مغلقة دائمًا
              icon = Icons.lock;
              label = "locked".tr();
            } else {
              // الأشهر الحالية والماضية
              if (updatedGroup.canManage) {
                // للإدارة: الشهر يظهر مفتوح ما دام لم يكتمل
                icon = Icons.hourglass_bottom;
                label = "open".tr();
              } else {
                // للعضو العادي
                if (isPaid) {
                  icon = Icons.check_circle;
                  label = "paid".tr();
                } else if (requested) {
                  icon = Icons.hourglass_top;
                  label = "underReview".tr();
                } else {
                  icon = Icons.payments;
                  label = "pay".tr();
                  action = () => provider.requestPayment(updatedGroup, month, updatedGroup.myUserId);
                }
              }
            }

            return Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: monthDate == currentMonth ? Colors.blue.withValues(alpha: 0.05) : Colors.transparent,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
              ),
             child: ListTile(
                // منع التفاعل في وضع الأرشيف
                onTap: isCompleted ? null : () {
                  if (updatedGroup.canManage && !monthDate.isAfter(currentMonth)) {
                    Navigator.push(context, MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => PaymentMonthScreen(group: updatedGroup, month: month)));
