                    return;
                  }
                  if (!updatedGroup.canManage && !monthDate.isAfter(currentMonth)) {
                    if (!requested && !isPaid) {
                      provider.requestPayment(updatedGroup, month, updatedGroup.myUserId);
                    }
                  }
                },
                contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 4),
                title: Text(DateFormat.yMMM(context.locale.toString()).format(month)),
                trailing: Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Icon(
                      icon,
                      color: label == "paid".tr() ? Colors.green
                          : label == "underReview".tr() ? Colors.orange
                          : label == "pay".tr() ? Colors.blue : Colors.grey,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                    GestureDetector(
                      onTap: action,
                      child: Text(
                        label,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          color: action != null ? Colors.blue : null,
                          fontWeight: action != null ? FontWeight.bold : null,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }
}
// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\screens\groups\group_details\payment_month_screen.dart ---
// lib/screens/groups/group_details/payment_month_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';
import '../../../models/group_model.dart';
import '../../../providers/group_provider.dart';
import '../../../widgets/user_name_text.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

class PaymentMonthScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final Group group;
  final DateTime month;
  
  const PaymentMonthScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.group,
    required this.month,
  });

  @override
  State<PaymentMonthScreen> createState() => _PaymentMonthScreenState();
}

class _PaymentMonthScreenState extends State<PaymentMonthScreen> {
  bool isProcessing = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final monthName = DateFormat.yMMM(context.locale.toString()).format(widget.month);
    final provider = context.read<GroupProvider>();
    
    final key = Group.generateMonthKey(widget.month);
    final updatedGroup = provider.getGroup(widget.group.id);
    
    if (updatedGroup == null) return const Scaffold(body: SizedBox());

    final isMonthCompleted = updatedGroup.paidMonths.contains(key);

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(monthName),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.notifications),
            onPressed: (isMonthCompleted || isProcessing)
                ? null
                : () async {
                    setState(() => isProcessing = true);
                    try {
                      await provider.sendPaymentReminder(updatedGroup, widget.month);
                      if (!context.mounted) return;
                      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text("reminderSent".tr())));
                    } catch (e) {
                      if (!context.mounted) return;
                      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text("error_generic".tr())));
                    } finally {
                      if (mounted) setState(() => isProcessing = false);
                    }
                  },
          ),
          if (updatedGroup.canManage && !isMonthCompleted)
            IconButton(
              icon: isProcessing 
                  ? const SizedBox(width: 16, height: 16, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2))
                  : const Icon(Icons.done_all),
              tooltip: "markAllPaid".tr(),
              onPressed: isProcessing ? null : () async {
                setState(() => isProcessing = true);
                try {
                  await provider.markEntireMonthAsPaid(updatedGroup, widget.month);
                  if (!context.mounted) return;
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text("monthCompleted".tr())));
                } finally {
                  if (mounted) setState(() => isProcessing = false);
                }
              },
            ),
        ],
      ),
      body: Consumer<GroupProvider>(
        builder: (context, provider, _) {
          final updatedGroup = provider.getGroup(widget.group.id);
          if (updatedGroup == null) return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());

          final key = Group.generateMonthKey(widget.month);
          final now = DateTime.now();
          final currentMonth = DateTime(now.year, now.month);
          final thisMonth = DateTime(widget.month.year, widget.month.month);
          
          final isMonthCompleted = updatedGroup.paidMonths.contains(key);
          final isFuture = thisMonth.isAfter(currentMonth);

          return ListView.builder(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            itemCount: updatedGroup.members.length,
            itemBuilder: (_, index) {
              final member = updatedGroup.members[index];
              final isPaid = updatedGroup.isMemberPaid(key, member);
              final pendingKey = "${key}_pending";
              final isPending = updatedGroup.payments[pendingKey]?.contains(member) ?? false;

              Widget trailing;

              if (isMonthCompleted || isPaid) {
                trailing = const Icon(Icons.check_circle, color: Colors.green);
              } else if (isFuture) {
                trailing = const Icon(Icons.lock, color: Colors.grey);
              } else if (isPending) {
                if (updatedGroup.canManage) {
                  trailing = Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      TextButton(
                        onPressed: isProcessing ? null : () async {
                          setState(() => isProcessing = true);
                          try {
                            await provider.markMemberAsPaid(updatedGroup, widget.month, member);
                          } finally {
                            if (mounted) setState(() => isProcessing = false);
                          }
                        },
                        child: Text("confirm".tr()),
                      ),
                      TextButton(
                        onPressed: isProcessing ? null : () async {
                          setState(() => isProcessing = true);
                          try {
                            await provider.rejectPaymentRequest(updatedGroup, widget.month, member);
                          } finally {
                            if (mounted) setState(() => isProcessing = false);
                          }
                        },
                        child: Text("reject".tr(), style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
                      ),
                    ],
                  );
                } else {
                  trailing = Text("underReview".tr());
                }
              } else {
                trailing = const Icon(Icons.hourglass_bottom);
              }

              return Card(
                child: ListTile(
                  onTap: (!isPaid && !isFuture && !isPending && updatedGroup.canManage && !isProcessing)
                      ? () async {
                          setState(() => isProcessing = true);
                          try {
                            await provider.markMemberAsPaid(updatedGroup, widget.month, member);
                          } finally {
                            if (mounted) setState(() => isProcessing = false);
                          }
                        }
                      : null,
                  title: UserNameText(uid: member, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w500)),
                  trailing: trailing,
                ),
              );
            },
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}
// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\screens\groups\group_details\schedule_tab.dart ---
// lib/screens/groups/group_details/schedule_tab.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';
import '../../../models/group_model.dart';
import '../../../widgets/user_name_text.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

class ScheduleTab extends StatelessWidget {
  final Group group;

  const ScheduleTab({super.key, required this.group});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final order =
        group.receiverOrder.isNotEmpty ? group.receiverOrder : group.members;

    if (!group.distributionStarted) {
      return Center(
        child: Text(
          "waitingLeader".tr(),
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
        ),
      );
    }

    if (order.isEmpty) {
      return Center(child: Text("noMembers".tr()));
    }

    // ⭐ SAFE FIX: بناء الجدول الأساسي بناءً على الأعضاء الحقيقيين فقط
    return ListView.builder(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      itemCount: order.length,
      itemBuilder: (_, i) {
        // استخراج أول شهر استلام كإشارة لبداية دور العضو
        final dt = DateTime(group.startDate.year, group.startDate.month + i);
        final monthLabel =
            DateFormat.yMMM(context.locale.toString()).format(dt);

        final receiverUid = order[i];

        final now = DateTime.now();
        final currentMonth = DateTime(now.year, now.month);
        final thisMonth = DateTime(dt.year, dt.month);

        final isPast = thisMonth.isBefore(currentMonth);
        final isCurrent = thisMonth.year == currentMonth.year &&
            thisMonth.month == currentMonth.month;
        final isMe = receiverUid == group.myUserId;

        return ListTile(
          leading: Icon(
            isPast
                ? Icons.check_circle
                : isCurrent
                    ? Icons.radio_button_checked
                    : Icons.circle_outlined,
            color: isPast
                ? Colors.grey
                : isCurrent
                    ? Colors.green
                    : Colors.blue,
          ),
          title: Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    // ⭐ FIX: Add Flexible to stop long names from pushing "(You)" off-screen and crashing
                    Flexible(
                      child: UserNameText(
                        uid: receiverUid,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          color: isPast
                              ? Colors.grey
                              : isCurrent
                                  ? Colors.green
                                  : Colors.blue,
                          fontWeight: isMe ? FontWeight.bold : null,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (isMe)
                      Text(" (${"you".tr()})",
                          style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              Text(
                " — $monthLabel",
                style: TextStyle(
                    color: isPast
                        ? Colors.grey
                        : isCurrent
                            ? Colors.green
                            : Colors.blue),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\screens\home\home_screen.dart ---
// lib/screens/home_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';

import '../../providers/group_provider.dart';
import '../../widgets/group_card.dart';
import '../groups/group_details/group_details_screen.dart';
import '../../core/utils/group_intelligence.dart'; 
import '../../models/group_model.dart';

import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:flutter/gestures.dart';
import '../about/about_screen.dart';

class HomeScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const HomeScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<HomeScreen> createState() => _HomeScreenState();
}

class _HomeScreenState extends State<HomeScreen> {

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _checkIntroBanner(); // ⭐ استدعاء الدالة الصحيحة المسؤولة عن عرض البانر الثابت
  }

  bool _showIntroBanner = false; // ⭐ متغير للتحكم بظهور البانر

  Future<void> _checkIntroBanner() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    // نفحص ما إذا كان المستخدم قد ضغط على (X) مسبقاً
    final isDismissed = prefs.getBool('intro_banner_dismissed') ?? false;

    // تظهر البطاقة فقط وتبقى ثابتة إذا لم يسبق له إغلاقها
    if (!isDismissed && mounted) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        setState(() => _showIntroBanner = true);
      });
    }
  }

  // ⭐ دالة الإغلاق اليدوي الدائم
  Future<void> _dismissIntroBanner() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setBool('intro_banner_dismissed', true); // حفظ الإغلاق نهائياً
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() => _showIntroBanner = false);
    }
  }

  

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final locale = context.locale; // ⭐ Dependency for language instant updates
    final allGroups = context.watch<GroupProvider>().groups;

    final active = allGroups.where((g) => !GroupIntelligence.isCompleted(g)).toList();
    final totalMonthly = active.fold<int>(
      0,
      (p, g) => p + g.monthlyAmount,
    );

    return Stack( // ⭐ التعديل هنا: أضفنا Stack
      children: [
        // 1️⃣ المحتوى الأساسي للصفحة (كما هو بدون تغيير)
        Container(
          color: const Color(0xFFF6F8F7),
          child: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        
        children: [
          Consumer<GroupProvider>(
            builder: (context, provider, _) {
              final uid = provider.currentUserId;
              final fullName = provider.getUserName(uid);
              
              if (fullName == null) {
                WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
                  provider.loadUserName(uid);
                });
              }

              // جلب الاسم الأول فقط
              final firstName = (fullName != null && fullName.trim().isNotEmpty) 
                  ? fullName.trim().split(' ').first 
                  : "";

              return Text(
                firstName.isNotEmpty 
                    ? "welcomeBackName".tr(args: [firstName]) 
                    : "${"welcomeBack".tr()} 👋",
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 22,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          // ⭐ PREMIUM DASHBOARD CARD
          Container(
            width: double.infinity,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 24),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              gradient: const LinearGradient(
                colors: [Color(0xFF0F7B6C), Color(0xFF0A5E52)], // ⭐ Subtle depth gradient
                begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                end: Alignment.bottomRight,
              ),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
              boxShadow: [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: const Color(0xFF0F7B6C).withOpacity(0.25),
                  blurRadius: 14,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 6),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            child: active.isEmpty
                ? Center(
                    child: Text(
                      "noActiveGroup".tr(),
                      style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, fontSize: 15),
                    ),
                  )
                : Row(
                    children: [
                      // 📌 STATIC COLUMN (العناوين)
                      Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Container(height: 28, alignment: Alignment.centerLeft, child: Text("groupNameLabel".tr(), style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500))),
                          const SizedBox(height: 16),
                          Container(height: 28, alignment: Alignment.centerLeft, child: Text("paymentStatusThisMonth".tr(), style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500))),
                          const SizedBox(height: 16),
                          Container(height: 28, alignment: Alignment.centerLeft, child: Text("completedMonthsLabel".tr(), style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500))),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 16),
                      // 📌 DYNAMIC COLUMNS (أعمدة الجروبات)
                      Expanded(
                        child: SingleChildScrollView(
                          scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                          physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                          child: Row(
                            children: active.map((group) {
                              final currentMonthKey = Group.generateMonthKey(DateTime.now());
                              final provider = context.read<GroupProvider>();
                              final isPaidThisMonth = group.isMemberPaid(currentMonthKey, provider.currentUserId);
                              final totalMonths = GroupIntelligence.totalMonths(group);
                              final completedMonths = GroupIntelligence.passedMonths(group);

                              return Padding(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
                                child: Column(
                                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                  children: [
                                    // 1. Group Name
                                    Container(
                                      height: 28, 
                                      alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                                      child: Text(
                                        group.name.length > 12 ? '${group.name.substring(0, 12)}...' : group.name, 
                                        style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 15),
                                      )
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                                    // 2. Status Badge (Pill Design)
                                    Container(
                                      height: 28, 
                                      alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                                      child: Container(
                                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                          color: isPaidThisMonth ? Colors.greenAccent.withOpacity(0.12) : Colors.orangeAccent.withOpacity(0.12),
                                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                                          border: Border.all(color: isPaidThisMonth ? Colors.greenAccent.withOpacity(0.3) : Colors.orangeAccent.withOpacity(0.3)),
                                        ),
                                        child: Row(
                                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                          children: [
                                            Icon(
                                              isPaidThisMonth ? Icons.check_circle_outline : Icons.error_outline,
                                              color: isPaidThisMonth ? Colors.greenAccent : Colors.orangeAccent,
                                              size: 14,
                                            ),
                                            const SizedBox(width: 4),
                                            Text(
                                              isPaidThisMonth ? "paidStatus".tr() : "notPaidStatus".tr(), 
                                              style: TextStyle(color: isPaidThisMonth ? Colors.greenAccent : Colors.orangeAccent, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, fontSize: 12),
                                            ),
                                          ],
                                        ),
                                      )
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                                    // 3. Progress Score
                                    Container(
                                      height: 28, 
                                      alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                                      child: Text(
                                        "monthsProgress".tr(args: [completedMonths.toString(), totalMonths.toString()]),

                            }).toList(),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 24),
          Text(
            "yourGroups".tr(),
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 18,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          ...active.map((g) => Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),

                  group: g,

                      context,

                      Wrap(
                        crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center, // محاذاة في المنتصف
                        children: [
                          const Text(
                            "لمعرفة المزيد عن التطبيق وميزاته، يمكنك زيارة قسم ",

                          ),
                          // ⭐ الرابط مع تأثير الضغط (Ripple Effect) الأنيق
                          Material(
                            color: Colors.transparent,
                            child: InkWell(
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                              splashColor: const Color(0xFF0F7B6C).withOpacity(0.2), // تأثير النقر
                              highlightColor: const Color(0xFF0F7B6C).withOpacity(0.1),
                              onTap: () {
                                // الإغلاق التلقائي (اختياري) والانتقال فوراً لصفحة About
                                Navigator.push(context, MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const AboutScreen()));
                              },

                                padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 2),

                                  "حول التطبيق.",

                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),

                      color: Colors.transparent,

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../layouts/main_scaffold.dart';
import '../groups/my_groups_screen.dart';
import '../home/home_screen.dart';
import '../profile/profile_screen.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';

import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../../providers/group_provider.dart';
import '../../services/notification_service.dart';

class MainNavigation extends StatefulWidget {
  const MainNavigation({super.key});

  @override
  State<MainNavigation> createState() => _MainNavigationState();
}

class _MainNavigationState extends State<MainNavigation> {
  int index = 0;

  // ⭐ أضف هذه الدالة (initState) بالكامل هنا ⭐
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      context.read<GroupProvider>().loadGroups();
      NotificationService.requestPermissionAndSaveToken();
    });
  }

  // ⭐ FIX: Removed const to allow rebuilding children when language changes
  late final List<Widget> pages = [
    HomeScreen(),
    MyGroupsScreen(),
    ProfileScreen(),
  ];
  
  

  List<String> titles(BuildContext context) => [
        "app_name".tr(),
        "my_groups".tr(),
        "profile".tr(),
      ];

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final locale = context.locale; // ⭐ Dependency for language instant updates
    
    return MainScaffold(
      title: titles(context)[index],
      body: pages[index],
      currentIndex: index,
      onSelectPage: (i) {
        setState(() => index = i);
      },
    );
  }
}
// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\screens\notifications\notifications_screen.dart ---
// lib/screens/notifications/notifications_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';
import '../../models/notification_model.dart';
import 'package:app_badge_plus/app_badge_plus.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

class NotificationsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const NotificationsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<NotificationsScreen> createState() => _NotificationsScreenState();
}

class _NotificationsScreenState extends State<NotificationsScreen> {
  bool _markedReadOnce = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted) {
        AppBadgePlus.updateBadge(0);
        _markAllAsRead();
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _markAllAsRead() async {
    if (_markedReadOnce) return;
    _markedReadOnce = true;

    final uid = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser!.uid;
    final snapshot = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('users')
        .doc(uid)
        .collection('notifications')
        .where('read', isEqualTo: false)
        .get();
        
    if (snapshot.docs.isEmpty) return;

    final batch = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
    for (final doc in snapshot.docs) {
      batch.update(doc.reference, {"read": true});
    }
    
    await batch.commit();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final uid = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser!.uid;
    
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text("notifications".tr()),
      ),
      body: StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot>(
        stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
            .collection('users')
            .doc(uid)
            .collection('notifications')
            .orderBy('createdAt', descending: true)
            .snapshots(),
        builder: (context, snapshot) {
          if (snapshot.hasError) {
             return Center(child: Text("error_generic".tr()));
          }

          if (!snapshot.hasData) {
            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          }

          final docs = snapshot.data!.docs;

          if (docs.isEmpty) {
            return Center(
              child: Text("no_notifications".tr()),
            );
          }

          final notifications = docs
              .map((d) => AppNotification.fromFirestore(
                    d.id,
                    d.data() as Map<String, dynamic>,
                  ))
              .toList();

          return ListView.builder(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            itemCount: notifications.length,
            itemBuilder: (_, i) {
              final n = notifications[i];
              return Card(
                child: ListTile(
                  leading: const Icon(Icons.notifications),
                  title: Text(
                    n.message.tr(
                      namedArgs: Map<String, String>.from(n.args ?? {}),
                    ),
                  ),
                  subtitle: Text(
                    DateFormat.yMMMd(context.locale.toString())
                        .add_jm()
                        .format(n.createdAt),
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
                  ),
                  trailing: IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.delete, color: Colors.red),
                    onPressed: () {
                      FirebaseFirestore.instance
                          .collection('users')
                          .doc(uid)
                          .collection('notifications')
                          .doc(n.id)
                          .delete();
                    },
                  ),
                ),
              );
            },
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';

import '../../providers/group_provider.dart';
import '../groups/group_details/group_details_screen.dart';

import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';

class ProfileScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const ProfileScreen({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final locale = context.locale; // ⭐ Dependency for language instant updates
    final uid = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser!.uid;

    final provider = context.watch<GroupProvider>();
    final active = provider.active;
    final completed = provider.completed;

    return ListView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      children: [
        const SizedBox(height: 20),
        const Center(child: CircleAvatar(radius: 40)),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),

        StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot>(
          stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection("users").doc(uid).snapshots(),
          builder: (context, snapshot) {
            if (snapshot.hasError) {
               return const Center(child: Text("Error loading profile."));
            }

            if (!snapshot.hasData) {
              return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
            }

            final data = snapshot.data!.data() as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};

            return Column(
              children: [
                Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      data["name"] ?? "user".tr(),
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 22,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    GestureDetector(
                      onTap: () => _showEditNameDialog(context, uid, data["name"] ?? ""),
                      child: const Icon(Icons.edit_rounded, size: 20, color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C)),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
               const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text("@${data["username"] ?? ''}", style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey)),
                
                // ⭐ قسم رمز الدخول بتصميم احترافي متكامل
                if (data["recoveryCode"] != null) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 32), // مسافة مريحة للعين
                  Container(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                      border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade200),
                      boxShadow: [
                        BoxShadow(
                          color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.03),
                          blurRadius: 10,
                          offset: const Offset(0, 4),
                        )
                      ],
                    ),
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        const Row(
                          children: [
                            Icon(Icons.vpn_key_rounded, color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C), size: 20),
                            SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Text("رمز الدخول", style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 16)),
                          ],
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 4),
                        const Text("هذا رمز الدخول الخاص بك", style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey, fontSize: 13)),
                        const SizedBox(height: 16),
                        Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: const Color(0xFFF6F8F7),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFF0F7B6C).withOpacity(0.2)),
                          ),
                          child: Row(
                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                            children: [
                              Text(
                                data["recoveryCode"],
                                style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, letterSpacing: 2.0, fontSize: 18, color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C)),
                              ),
                              GestureDetector(
                                onTap: () {
                                  Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: data["recoveryCode"]));
                                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text("تم نسخ رمز الدخول")));
                                },
                                child: const Icon(Icons.copy_rounded, color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C), size: 22),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            );
          },
        ),

        const SizedBox(height: 24),

        Text(
          "groupsHistory".tr(),
          style: const TextStyle(
            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            fontSize: 18,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        ...active.map((g) => Card(
              child: ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.circle, color: Colors.green, size: 12),
                title: Text(g.name),
                subtitle: Text(
                  "${_monthName(g.startDate.month)} ${g.startDate.year} → "
                  "${_monthName(g.endDate.month)} ${g.endDate.year}",
                ),
                trailing: Text(
                  "monthly_amount".tr(args: [g.monthlyAmount.toString()]),
                ),
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.push(
                    context,
                    MaterialPageRoute(
                      builder: (_) => GroupDetailsScreen(group: g),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              ),
            )),
        ...completed.map((g) => Card(
              child: ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.circle, color: Colors.grey, size: 12),
                title: Text(g.name),
                subtitle: Text(
                  "${_monthName(g.startDate.month)} ${g.startDate.year} → "
                  "${_monthName(g.endDate.month)} ${g.endDate.year}",
                ),
                trailing: Text("₹${g.monthlyAmount} / month"),
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.push(
                    context,
                    MaterialPageRoute(
                      builder: (_) => GroupDetailsScreen(group: g),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              ),
            )),
      ],
    );
  }

  static String _monthName(int m) {
    const names = [
      '',
      'Jan',
      'Feb',
      'Mar',
      'Apr',
      'May',
      'Jun',
      'Jul',
      'Aug',
      'Sep',
      'Oct',
      'Nov',
      'Dec'
    ];
    return names[m];
  }

  void _showEditNameDialog(BuildContext context, String uid, String currentName) {
    final controller = TextEditingController(text: currentName);
    bool isLoading = false;

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (dialogContext) {
        return StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (context, setState) {
            return AlertDialog(
              title: Text("editName".tr()),
              content: TextField(
                controller: controller,
                enabled: !isLoading,
                maxLength: 25,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  hintText: "yourName".tr(),
                ),
              ),
              actions: [
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: isLoading ? null : () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
                  child: Text("cancel".tr()),
                ),
                ElevatedButton(
                  onPressed: isLoading
                      ? null
                      : () async {
                          final newName = controller.text.trim();
                          if (newName.length < 2) {
                            ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                              SnackBar(content: Text("error_name_length".tr())),
                            );
                            return;
                          }

                          setState(() => isLoading = true);
                          try {
                            await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection("users").doc(uid).update({"name": newName});
                            
                            // تحديث الاسم فوراً في الذاكرة المؤقتة ليعكس التغيير في كل مكان
                            if (context.mounted) {
                              context.read<GroupProvider>().updateCachedUserName(uid, newName);
                            }

                            if (dialogContext.mounted) Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
                            if (context.mounted) {
                              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                                SnackBar(content: Text("nameUpdated".tr())),
                              );
                            }
                          } catch (e) {
                            setState(() => isLoading = false);
                            if (context.mounted) {
                              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                                SnackBar(content: Text("error_generic".tr())),
                              );
                            }
                          }
                        },
                  child: isLoading
                      ? const SizedBox(height: 18, width: 18, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2))
                      : Text("saveChanges".tr()),
                ),
              ],
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import '../models/group_model.dart';
import '../data/mock/mock_groups.dart';

/// ⚠️ DEPRECATION WARNING:
/// This static mock service is an architectural anti-pattern for this app.
/// State management and Firebase integration are handled by [GroupProvider] 
/// and [GroupRepository]. 
/// 
/// DO NOT use this service in production UI. Use `context.watch<GroupProvider>().groups` instead.
class GroupService {

  /// ✅ Get all groups (Mock حاليا — Firebase لاحقاً)
  @Deprecated('Use GroupProvider.groups instead to get real reactive data')
  static List<Group> getGroups() {
    return MockGroups.groups;
  }

  /// ✅ Active groups only
  @Deprecated('Use GroupProvider.active instead to get real reactive data')
  static List<Group> getActiveGroups() {
    return MockGroups.groups
        .where((g) => !g.isCompleted)
        .toList();
  }

  /// ✅ Completed groups
  @Deprecated('Use GroupProvider.completed instead to get real reactive data')
  static List<Group> getCompletedGroups() {
    return MockGroups.groups
        .where((g) => g.isCompleted)
        .toList();
  }
}
// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\services\notification_service.dart ---
// lib/services/notification_service.dart

import 'package:firebase_messaging/firebase_messaging.dart';
import 'package:flutter_local_notifications/flutter_local_notifications.dart';
import 'package:app_badge_plus/app_badge_plus.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';

import 'package:firebase_core/firebase_core.dart'; // تأكد من استيراده

@pragma('vm:entry-point')
Future<void> _firebaseMessagingBackgroundHandler(RemoteMessage message) async {
  // ⭐ FIX: تأمين التهيئة في الباكجراوند لمنع الـ Duplicate App Crash
  if (Firebase.apps.isEmpty) {
    await Firebase.initializeApp();
  }
  print("Handling a background message: ${message.messageId}");
}

class NotificationService {
  static final FirebaseMessaging _messaging = FirebaseMessaging.instance;
  static final FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin _localNotifications = FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin();

  static Future<void> initialize() async {
    FirebaseMessaging.onBackgroundMessage(_firebaseMessagingBackgroundHandler);

    FirebaseMessaging.instance.onTokenRefresh.listen((newToken) async {
      await _updateTokenInFirestore(newToken);
    });

    // ⭐ SAFE FIX: تم نقل طلب الإذن لأسفل ليعمل للمستخدم المسجل فقط

    const AndroidInitializationSettings androidSettings = AndroidInitializationSettings('@mipmap/ic_launcher');
    const InitializationSettings settings = InitializationSettings(android: androidSettings);

    await _localNotifications.initialize(settings);

    const AndroidNotificationChannel channel = AndroidNotificationChannel(
      'jam3iya_channel',
      'Jam3iya Notifications',
      importance: Importance.max,
    );

    await _localNotifications
        .resolvePlatformSpecificImplementation<AndroidFlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin>()
        ?.createNotificationChannel(channel);

    FirebaseMessaging.onMessage.listen((RemoteMessage message) async {
      final notification = message.notification;

      if (notification != null) {
        try {
          await _localNotifications.show(
            notification.hashCode,
            notification.title,
            notification.body,
            const NotificationDetails(
              android: AndroidNotificationDetails(
                'jam3iya_channel',
                'Jam3iya Notifications',
                importance: Importance.max,
                priority: Priority.high,
              ),
            ),
          );
        } catch (e) {
          print("Notification UI Error: $e");
        }

        final user = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
        if (user == null) return;

        try {
          final snapshot = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
              .collection('users')
              .doc(user.uid)
              .collection('notifications')
              .where('read', isEqualTo: false)
              .get();

          final count = snapshot.docs.length;
          if (await AppBadgePlus.isSupported()) {
            AppBadgePlus.updateBadge(count);
          }
        } catch (e) {
          print("Failed to update badge: $e");
        }
      }
    });
  }

  static Future<void> saveFCMToken() async {
    try {
      final String? token = await _messaging.getToken();
      if (token != null) {
        await _updateTokenInFirestore(token);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print("Failed to get FCM token: $e");
    }
  }

  static Future<void> _updateTokenInFirestore(String token) async {
    final user = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    if (user == null) return; 

    try {
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('users')
          .doc(user.uid)
          .set({
        "fcmToken": token,
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (e) {
      print("Failed to save FCM token to Firestore: $e");
    }
  }

  static Future<void> requestPermissionAndSaveToken() async {
    // تم إيقاف نافذة طلب الإذن المزعجة نهائياً بناءً على طلبك
    /* 
    await _messaging.requestPermission(
      alert: true,
      badge: true,
      sound: true,
    );
    */

    // نكتفي بتوليد الـ Token وحفظه في الخلفية بصمت تام
    await saveFCMToken();
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../screens/notifications/notifications_screen.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';

class AppAppBar extends StatelessWidget implements PreferredSizeWidget {
  final String title;

  const AppAppBar({super.key, required this.title});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final user = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    
    return AppBar(
      elevation: 0,
      backgroundColor: Colors.white,
      centerTitle: true,

      leading: Builder(
        builder: (context) => IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(
            Icons.menu,
            color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C),
          ),
          onPressed: () => Scaffold.of(context).openDrawer(),
        ),
      ),

      title: Text(
        title.toUpperCase(),
        style: const TextStyle(
          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
          letterSpacing: 1,
          color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C),
        ),
      ),

      actions: [
        if (user != null) 
          StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot>(
            stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
                .collection('users')
                .doc(user.uid)
                .collection('notifications')
                .where('read', isEqualTo: false)
                .snapshots(),
            builder: (context, snapshot) {
              if (snapshot.hasError) return const SizedBox(); // SAFE GUARD
              
              int count = 0;
              if (snapshot.hasData) {
                count = snapshot.data!.docs.length;
              }

              return Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 12),
                child: Stack(
                  children: [
                    IconButton(
                      icon: const Icon(
                        Icons.notifications_none,
                        color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C),
                      ),
                      onPressed: () {
                        Navigator.push(
                          context,
                          MaterialPageRoute(
                            builder: (_) => const NotificationsScreen(),
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                    if (count > 0)
                      Positioned(
                        right: 6,
                        top: 6,
                        child: Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: const Color(0xFFD32F2F),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          ),
                          constraints: const BoxConstraints(
                            minWidth: 18,
                            minHeight: 18,
                          ),
                          child: Text(
                            '$count',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              color: Colors.white,
                              fontSize: 11,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            ),
                            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            },
          )
      ],
    );
  }

  @override
  Size get preferredSize => const Size.fromHeight(kToolbarHeight);
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class AppDrawer extends StatelessWidget {

  @override

    final locale = context.locale; // Ensure drawer translates instantly

    return Drawer(

              ],

          ),
          ListTile(

              );

              );
            },
          ),
          const Spacer(),
          ListTile(
            leading: const Icon(Icons.logout),
            title: Text("logout".tr()),

              // FIX: Capture navigator strictly before context is popped to ensure proper routing
              final nav = Navigator.of(context);
              nav.pop(); 
              
              await FirebaseAuth.instance.signOut();
              
              nav.pushAndRemoveUntil(
                MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const WelcomeScreen()),
                (route) => false,
              );
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\widgets\countdown_text.dart ---
// lib/widgets/countdown_text.dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';

class CountdownText extends StatefulWidget {
  final DateTime targetDate;

  const CountdownText({super.key, required this.targetDate});

  @override
  State<CountdownText> createState() => _CountdownTextState();
}

class _CountdownTextState extends State<CountdownText> {
  late Timer timer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() {});
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    timer.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String format() {
    final diff = widget.targetDate.difference(DateTime.now());

    if (diff.isNegative) return "completed".tr();

    String two(int n) => n.toString().padLeft(2, '0');

    return "${diff.inDays}d ${two(diff.inHours % 24)}h ${two(diff.inMinutes % 60)}m ${two(diff.inSeconds % 60)}s";
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(
          "receive_after".tr(),
          style: const TextStyle(
            fontSize: 13,
            color: Colors.black54,
          ),
        ),
        Text(
          format(),
          style: const TextStyle(
            fontSize: 16,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\widgets\empty_state.dart ---

// --- FILE: C:\Users\nawaf\jam3iya_app\lib\widgets\group_card.dart ---
// lib/widgets/group_card.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../models/group_model.dart';
import '../core/utils/group_intelligence.dart';
import 'countdown_text.dart';
import '../widgets/user_name_text.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';

enum CardStatus { red, blue, green, grey }

class GroupCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final Group group;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final bool showGroupDetails;

  const GroupCard({
    super.key,
    required this.group,
    this.onTap,
    this.showGroupDetails = false,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isPendingApproval = group.pendingMembers.contains(group.myUserId);
    final isDistributionNotStarted = !group.distributionStarted;
    final order = group.receiverOrder.isNotEmpty ? group.receiverOrder : group.members;
    
    // SAFE GUARD: Avoid crash if group has 0 active members somehow
    if (order.isEmpty) return const SizedBox();
    
    final totalMembers = order.length;
    final currentIndex = GroupIntelligence.currentReceiverIndex(group, totalMembers);
    final isTimeNotStarted = currentIndex == -1;

    final isCompleted = GroupIntelligence.isCompleted(group);

    // حساب المبلغ المدفوع الكلي للمستخدم
    int paidCount = 0;
    for (var entry in group.payments.entries) {
      if (entry.key.endsWith("_pending")) continue;
      if (entry.value.contains(group.myUserId)) {
        paidCount++;
      }
    }
    final totalPaid = paidCount * group.monthlyAmount;
    final receiveAmount = group.monthlyAmount * totalMembers;

    // 1. Red Cards (Pre-start states)
    if (isPendingApproval) {
      return _buildCard(
        context,
        title: group.name,
        status: CardStatus.red,
        showPaidBar: false,
        subtitleWidget: _buildRedSubtitle("waiting_leader_approval", group.monthlyAmount),
      );
    }

    if (isDistributionNotStarted) {
      return _buildCard(
        context,
        title: group.name,
        status: CardStatus.red,
        showPaidBar: false,
        subtitleWidget: _buildRedSubtitle("waiting_leader_start", group.monthlyAmount),
      );
    }

    if (isTimeNotStarted) {
      return _buildCard(
        context,
        title: group.name,
        status: CardStatus.red,
        showPaidBar: false,
        subtitleWidget: _buildRedSubtitle("group_not_started", group.monthlyAmount),
      );
    }

    // 2. Grey Cards (Completed Groups)
    if (isCompleted) {
      return _buildCard(
        context,
        title: group.name,
        status: CardStatus.grey,
        showPaidBar: true,
        totalPaid: totalPaid,
        subtitleWidget: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            const Text(
              "Group Completed",
              style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.grey),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text(
              "you_received_amount".tr(args: [receiveAmount.toString()]),
              style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFD4AF37), fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

   // 3. Active Groups (Blue or Green Cards)
    final myIndex = order.indexOf(group.myUserId);
    if (myIndex == -1) return const SizedBox(); // Fallback if user missing

    final currentReceiver = order[currentIndex];
    final hasNextReceiver = currentIndex < totalMembers - 1;
    final nextIndex = hasNextReceiver ? currentIndex + 1 : -1;
    final nextReceiver = hasNextReceiver ? order[nextIndex] : "";

    final isMyTurn = myIndex == currentIndex;
    final isNextTurn = hasNextReceiver && (myIndex == nextIndex);
    final alreadyReceived = myIndex < currentIndex;
    
    // ⭐ Helper Widget: لمنع تكرار الكود وعرض "اكتملت الجمعية" إن لم يوجد مستلم تالي
    final Widget nextReceiverWidget = !hasNextReceiver
        ? Text("jam3iya_completed_status".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.grey, fontSize: 13))
        : UserNameText(uid: nextReceiver, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600));

    final status = isMyTurn ? CardStatus.green : CardStatus.blue;
    
    int monthsUntilTurn;
    if (myIndex >= currentIndex) {
      monthsUntilTurn = myIndex - currentIndex;
    } else {
      monthsUntilTurn = totalMembers - (currentIndex - myIndex);
    }
    
    final receiveDate = DateTime(
      group.startDate.year,
      group.startDate.month + currentIndex + monthsUntilTurn,
    );

    // === GROUP PAGE CARDS ===
    if (showGroupDetails) {
      Widget detailsContent;
      if (isMyTurn) {
        detailsContent = Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text("current_receiver".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.black54)),
            Text("your_turn".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.green)),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text("next_receiver".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.black54)),
            nextReceiverWidget,
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text("you_will_receive".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Colors.black54)),
            Text("₹$receiveAmount", style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 22, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color(0xFFD4AF37))),
          ],
        );
      } else if (isNextTurn) {
        detailsContent = Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text("current_receiver".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.black54)),
            UserNameText(uid: currentReceiver, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text("next_receiver".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.black54)),
            Text("your_turn_n".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.green)),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text("you_will_receive".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Colors.black54)),
            Text("₹$receiveAmount", style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 22, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color(0xFFD4AF37))),
          ],
        );
      } else if (alreadyReceived) {
        detailsContent = Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text("current_receiver".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.black54)),
            UserNameText(uid: currentReceiver, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text("next_receiver".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.black54)),
            nextReceiverWidget,
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text("already_received".tr(), style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.green, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
            Text("you_received_amount".tr(args: [receiveAmount.toString()]), style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFD4AF37))),
          ],
        );
      } else {
        // Later in queue
        detailsContent = Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text("current_receiver".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.black54)),
            UserNameText(uid: currentReceiver, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text("next_receiver".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.black54)),
            nextReceiverWidget,
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text("your_turn_date".tr(args: [_monthName(receiveDate.month), receiveDate.year.toString()]), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text("you_will_receive".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Colors.black54)),
            Text("₹$receiveAmount", style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 22, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color(0xFFD4AF37))),
          ],
        );
      }
      return _buildCard(
        context,
        title: group.name,
        status: status,
        showPaidBar: true,
        totalPaid: totalPaid,
        subtitleWidget: detailsContent,
      );
    } 
    // === HOME PAGE CARDS ===
    else {
      Widget homeContent;
      if (isMyTurn) {
        homeContent = Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text("your_turn".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.green)),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text("you_will_receive".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Colors.black54)),
            Text("₹$receiveAmount", style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 22, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color(0xFFD4AF37))),
          ],
        );
      } else if (alreadyReceived) {
        homeContent = Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text("current_receiver".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.black54)),
            UserNameText(uid: currentReceiver, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 15)),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text("already_received".tr(), style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.green, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
            Text("you_received_amount".tr(args: [receiveAmount.toString()]), style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFD4AF37))),
          ],
        );
      } else {
        // Not My Turn (Future)
        homeContent = Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text("time_remaining".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.orange)),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            CountdownText(targetDate: receiveDate),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text("you_will_receive".tr(), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Colors.black54)),
            Text("₹$receiveAmount", style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 22, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color(0xFFD4AF37))),
          ],
        );
      }
      return _buildCard(
        context,
        title: group.name,
        status: status,
        showPaidBar: true,
        totalPaid: totalPaid,
        subtitleWidget: homeContent,
      );
    }
  }

  Widget _buildRedSubtitle(String textKey, int amount) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(
          textKey.tr(),
          style: const TextStyle(
            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            color: Colors.orange,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),
        Text(
          "₹$amount / ${'month'.tr()}",
          style: const TextStyle(
            color: Colors.black54,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCard(
    BuildContext context, {
    required String title,
    required CardStatus status,
    required Widget subtitleWidget,
    bool showPaidBar = false,
    int totalPaid = 0,
  }) {
    Color topColor;
    switch (status) {
      case CardStatus.red: topColor = const Color(0xFFE53935); break;
      case CardStatus.blue: topColor = Colors.blue; break;
      case CardStatus.green: topColor = Colors.green; break;
      case CardStatus.grey: topColor = Colors.grey; break;
    }

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
      child: Material(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Container(
              height: 4,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: topColor,
                borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(
                  top: Radius.circular(18),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 120),
              curve: Curves.easeOut,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                boxShadow: [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
                    blurRadius: 8,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 4),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              child: InkWell(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                onTap: onTap,
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
                  child: Column(
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: const Color(0xFF0F7B6C).withValues(alpha: .08),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                            ),
                            child: const Icon(
                              Icons.groups,
                              color: Color(0xFF0F7B6C),
                              size: 24,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 14),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: [
                                Text(
                                  title,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                    fontSize: 17,
                                    color: Color(0xFF1A1A1A),
                                  ),
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                                Divider(
                                  height: 16,
                                  thickness: 1,
                                  color: Colors.grey.shade200,
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                                subtitleWidget,
                               ],
                            ),
                          ),
                          const Icon(
                            Icons.arrow_forward_ios,
                            size: 16,
                            color: Colors.grey,
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      if (showPaidBar) ...[
                        const SizedBox(height: 14),
                        Container(
                          width: double.infinity,
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 14,
                            vertical: 12,
                          ),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: const Color(0xFFF6F8F7),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                            border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade200),
                          ),
                          child: Row(
                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                            children: [
                              Text(
                                "you_paid".tr(),
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: Colors.black54,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                ),
                              ),
                              Text(
                                "₹$totalPaid",
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: Colors.green,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  fontSize: 16,
                                ),
                              ),
                             ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ]
                     ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  String _monthName(int m) {
    const names = [
      '', 'Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun',
      'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'
    ];
    return names[m];
  }
}

// lib/widgets/user_name_text.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart';
import '../providers/group_provider.dart';

class UserNameText extends StatelessWidget {
  final String uid;
  final TextStyle? style;
  final String prefix;
  final String suffix;

  const UserNameText({
    super.key,
    required this.uid,
    this.style,
    this.prefix = "",
    this.suffix = "",
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (uid.isEmpty) return const SizedBox();

    final provider = context.watch<GroupProvider>();
    final cachedName = provider.getUserName(uid);

    if (cachedName == null) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        provider.loadUserName(uid);
      });
      return Text(
        "$prefix...$suffix",
        style: style,
        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
      );
    }

    // FIX: Fallback accurately dynamically based on instant translation context, NO MORE RAW UIDs
    final displayName = cachedName.isEmpty ? "user".tr() : cachedName;

    return Text(
      "$prefix$displayName$suffix",
      style: style,
      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
    );
  }
}
